name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: An update on Michigan's 1931 abortion ban
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220801&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220801&amount=28]
Friend,
After the repeal of Roe v. Wade, I emailed you about a law from 1931 that Michigan currently has on the books that criminalizes abortion in almost all circumstances. I explained that the only reason that law had not snapped back into effect following Roe’s repeal was because of a temporary injunction from a Michigan judge. Well, today there were some disturbing updates on that front.
This morning, a ruling from the Michigan Court of Appeals found that ruling does not extend to county prosecutors. It was set to make real the 1931 ban on personal freedom in Michigan.
Within the last few hours, thanks to quick work from our state's Governor and Attorney General, a temporary restraining order has been granted to prevent enforcement of the 1931 law, at least while the order is pending .
This whiplash of today’s court rulings makes one thing clear: we must do away with it once and for all in order to preserve personal freedom and avoid the fear and confusion this ongoing litigation creates for providers and women across the state.
Allowing the ban to take full effect will have chilling consequences on services, no matter what county you live in, as doctors face the very real possibility that providing an abortion—even to a woman who has been raped, or who is in the middle of a miscarriage—could land them in jail. The law could also lead to local prosecutors bringing charges against women for their private choices, including basic pregnancy care sought by the one in four women who go through miscarriages of a wanted pregnancy.
We’re already seeing the horror stories starting to come out of places like Texas, where women in the middle of having a miscarriage are now being sent home and told to return when their fever gets higher or they bleed hard enough. No matter our political views, women understand how frightening this is for their lives and ability to have children in the future. That’s what this is about: the personal freedom to make private decisions without government interference.
My opponent has made it clear he wants the ban in place. He brags about being ‘100% Pro-Life—No Exceptions,’ including for rape or incest, and he’s led legislation that would allow prosecutors to bring additional criminal charges against doctors who provide reproductive care. For someone who talks A LOT about how much personal freedom means to him, he’s very willing to turn around and strip women of the freedom to make their own choices.
Fortunately, voters will have the final say on Michiganders’ personal freedom. Organizers submitted more than 750,000 signatures for a ballot initiative that would enshrine the Roe standard in Michigan’s constitution and invalidate the 1931 ban. It’s therefore up to Michigan voters to decide which way we want our state to go this November.

clean_body: Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220801&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220801&amount=28] Friend, After the repeal of Roe v. Wade, I emailed you about a law from 1931 that Michigan currently has on the books that criminalizes abortion in almost all circumstances. I explained that the only reason that law had not snapped back into effect following Roe’s repeal was because of a temporary injunction from a Michigan judge. Well, today there were some disturbing updates on that front. This morning, a ruling from the Michigan Court of Appeals found that ruling does not extend to county prosecutors. It was set to make real the 1931 ban on personal freedom in Michigan. Within the last few hours, thanks to quick work from our state's Governor and Attorney General, a temporary restraining order has been granted to prevent enforcement of the 1931 law, at least while the order is pending . This whiplash of today’s court rulings makes one thing clear: we must do away with it once and for all in order to preserve personal freedom and avoid the fear and confusion this ongoing litigation creates for providers and women across the state. Allowing the ban to take full effect will have chilling consequences on services, no matter what county you live in, as doctors face the very real possibility that providing an abortion—even to a woman who has been raped, or who is in the middle of a miscarriage—could land them in jail. The law could also lead to local prosecutors bringing charges against women for their private choices, including basic pregnancy care sought by the one in four women who go through miscarriages of a wanted pregnancy. We’re already seeing the horror stories starting to come out of places like Texas, where women in the middle of having a miscarriage are now being sent home and told to return when their fever gets higher or they bleed hard enough. No matter our political views, women understand how frightening this is for their lives and ability to have children in the future. That’s what this is about: the personal freedom to make private decisions without government interference. My opponent has made it clear he wants the ban in place. He brags about being ‘100% Pro-Life—No Exceptions,’ including for rape or incest, and he’s led legislation that would allow prosecutors to bring additional criminal charges against doctors who provide reproductive care. For someone who talks A LOT about how much personal freedom means to him, he’s very willing to turn around and strip women of the freedom to make their own choices. Fortunately, voters will have the final say on Michiganders’ personal freedom. Organizers submitted more than 750,000 signatures for a ballot initiative that would enshrine the Roe standard in Michigan’s constitution and invalidate the 1931 ban. It’s therefore up to Michigan voters to decide which way we want our state to go this November. clean_body: The lack of small-dollar donations on our side puts winning back the majority in serious jeopardy. | Fellow American, I'm not sure exactly why or how this is happening... but it's causing quite the stir. With President Biden's approval rating at just 38%, Democrats should be in no position to win the midterm elections. However, their grassroots donor base is highly motivated and is donating almost three times as much as our conservative donors. The lack of small-dollar donations on our side puts winning back the Senate majority in serious jeopardy. If we don't act quickly and close the fundraising gap among folks who give $5, $10 and $20, we're going to lose. I don't want that, and I know you don't want that.Most importantly, America can't afford that. I don't typically read The Washington Post , but someone pointed this article out to me...and the numbers about small-dollar donations don't lie: | "Both parties are raising less than they did at this point in the 2020 presidential election, as one would expect. But Democrats are much closer to those numbers, raising about half the nearly $127 million they raised in June 2020. Republicans, by contrast, have raised less than 30 percent of their June 2020 total of $94 million." What's more, according to the same article: "Democrats in June 2022 also raised more than double what they raised during the same month in the last midterm election cycle, in 2018." body:

---
| | Contact: Bryan Davis 815 262-5014
---
| State Representative Tony Kurtz to Endorse Charity Barry for 2nd Congressional District Seat (Madison) - State Representative Tony Kurtz, (R - Wisconsin Assembly District 50), will formally endorse Charity Barry who is running for the Republican nomination in the 2nd Congressional District of Wisconsin at a fundraising event scheduled for Wednesday, August 3rd in Reedsburg. Representative Kurtz represents the West Central region of Wisconsin in the Wisconsin Assembly.
The winner of the August 9th primary will face incumbent U.S. Representative Mark Pocan (D-WI2) in the November 8th general election race. Rep Kurtz is joining other Wisconsin state legislators who are already supporting Charity Barry's bid for Congress including State Representative William Penterman, (R-Wisconsin Assembly District 37), and State Representative Janel Brandtjen, (R-Wisconsin Assembly District 22).
"I am excited to support Charity Barry for Congress, who has demonstrated she has the energy, passion, and dedication to fight for the needs of the citizens of the Wisconsin 2nd Congressional District. It is inspiring to me to see a younger person like Charity willing to step up and serve her community, state, and nation as an elected official." - State Representative Tony Kurtz
"I am honored to receive the endorsement and support of Representative Kurtz. He is very well respected n the State Assembly and works hard to represent the interests of his constituents. He also served our nation as a helicopter pilot in the U.S. Army for 20 years and we thank him for his service to our country." - Charity Barry
The Charity Barry campaign fundraiser is to be held Wednesday, August 3rd from 5-7 p.m. at the Voyageur Inn and Conference Center, 200 Viking Drive, Reedsburg. Media is invited to attend.

He’s raised $2,000,000 for abortion access
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | Peter, Matt Gaetz must seriously regret mouthing off, and becoming one of the country’s best fundraising draws for abortion care access and youth organizing. It’s almost funny, and we hope he hates it. We told you Gaetz attacked pro-choice women at a right-wing conference, saying as part of his trademark idiocy, _" Why is it that women with the least likelihood of getting pregnant are the ones most worried about having abortions."_ Since, a few things have happened. **First, Gaetz was just exposed talking like a mobster on a recording from 2019, referring to Donald Trump as "The Boss" and telling Roger Stone he'd get a pardon on the eve of his 2019 trial where Stone could have implicated Trump (obstruction of justice?). ** _**But...the second update is SO MUCH BETTER.**_ **Julianna Orlanna the**** courageous teenage abortion rights activist, who responded to his indignity by [turning his insult into $460,000 in fundraising for ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7f80ccbb-9b08-4d33-9e23-9d5022699fc5/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)[_Gen Z For Choice Abortion Fund--_ which splits monies between the 50 states to ensure women who can't afford an abortion don't lose their right to choose](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb0fbd19d-bbf0-456a-8774-03bd61ca92b1/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), has an update for us.**
---
|
---
| | | | [DONATE NOW: GEN Z FOR CHANGE](https://default.salsalabs.org/T2d35d164-cbfa-4cc4-adc5-ee8923cfaa0d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| **_BREAKING: Olivia Julianna announced she has now raised $2,000,000, all thanks to Matt Gaetz!_** Utterly incredible. **Former Congressman and Texas Gubernatorial candidate, Beto O'Rourke, responded by having Julianna stand up at a speech of his, introducing Julianna as "the future of Texas" and telling everyone what she had done. She, quite naturally, received a standing ovation.** We at Blue Amp Action are also once again inspired by what this amazing young woman has done. _Taking something that could have hurt her and turning it into something that will help so many_. To be so mature at such a young age, while these pathetic men of the Republican Party wander around like lost little boys. [**So will you join me once again, in honor of Julianna, women across the country, and, as a big middle finger to Matt Gaetz, in giving $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to Gen Z For Change, so we can help women across the country continue to control of their lives?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T65322f2c-3747-4cb2-b99e-5fbf795c6020/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Thank you as always for all you do to fight for equality in our country. Cliff

Whether ready-to-use appliances, specialized distributions or your individual config, with custom images you can create cloud servers that are ideally prepared for their intended purpose from the very first start-up. Managing and using custom images has now become even easier, which means that you can build on the appropriate image in any situation.
\- Images as the base for new cloud servers - Managing custom images in the cloud control panel
Images as the base for new cloud servers
In order for new cloud servers to be available immediately, the operating system is not installed manually (e.g. from a DVD), but instead the root volume is prefilled with an image when a new cloud server is launched and this installation template is then further configured during the initial boot process.
You have been able to import and use your own images for a while now at. This enables you to create virtual servers in no time at all using a different operating system to those provided by us or using software and configurations that are completely adapted to your requirements. Where there are several available image files from distributors or third-party providers, it is often the case that one of them has been specifically optimized for OpenStack environments like at cloudscale.
Managing custom images in the cloud control panel
Managing custom images is now also possible in our web-based cloud control panel. Even if you are not using our API, the CLI or the DevOps tools we support, such as Terraform and Ansible, you can now import your own images at n order to start one or more virtual servers on this base. In addition, it is now possible to import images directly in QCOW2 format without needing to convert them to RAW first. It goes without saying that you also benefit from this simplified process if you continue to import images via API.
We recommend that you use `cloud-init` [1] for your own images, too. Using cloud-init, virtual servers can apply numerous settings automatically during the boot process, e.g. relating to the name and IP address of the server. You can also hand over many other options to cloud-init as "user data" at the time you create the server. In addition, you can specify for each custom image how our system should handle the user data. This is of particular significance if your image uses Ignition, which serves a similar purpose, rather than cloud-init. You will find further details about this in the documentation at [2].
Whether you are compiling a customized image with your preferred tools and settings or using a comprehensive complete package from a third-party provider, managing and using your custom images has now become even easier at

# COG DATA SHARING
## A. DATA REQUEST PROCEDURE
Consistent with the policies of the National Institutes of Health, COG considers requests from investigators who are not members of COG and to make its research data available to them. Investigators who wish to use individual patient data from one or more COG studies must make a formal request to the Group. The formal request must be in the form of a brief proposal as outlined below. The Group will then review the scientific merits and feasibility of the request.

Note: Requests for data will ordinarily be considered once the primary study analyses have been published. Nevertheless, consideration of requests for data will be entertained in the event that there are long delays in the publication of the primary study data.

The following information must be provided for requests for data from completed COG protocol research. The proposal must be no more the 5 pages. Proposals longer than 5 pages will be returned un-reviewed.
1) Title of research proposal
2) Project principal investigator(s), and contact information: address, phone number, e-mail address
3) COG protocol(s) from which project data is being requested
4) Project primary and secondary objectives
5) Description of the project's importance: what is to be learned from the research proposed to be performed using the data requested?
6) Description of the data elements requested and how these data will be used to address the primary and secondary objectives of the research
7) Brief description of how the project will be conducted
8) Description of funding plan for the project to include time and effort allocations for the Study Development Office and Statistics & Data Center
9) List of cases that are to be included in the dataset (e.g., list the study numbers), including what data items are required and descriptions of any exclusion restrictions

Requests for access to COG protocol research data should be sent to: [datarequest@childrensoncologygroup.org](mailto:datarequest@childrensoncologygroup.org)

The Group will conduct an internal review of the merit and feasibility of the proposal, including whether there are sufficient data to provide adequate information for analysis and if the required data are available. Investigators will be notified of the Group's decisions in writing within 6 weeks of receipt. If a request is denied, COG, in the written decision, will provide the reasons the request was denied and inform the investigators that a denied request may be appealed as outlined in the appeals process section below. Release of the data is subject to the conditions outlined in release conditions below.

## B. RELEASE CONDITIONS & DISCLAIMER
Release of data for research purposes is subject to the following conditions. A formal Data Use Agreement (DUA) covering the relevant conditions will usually be required.
* Investigators must agree to use the data only for the approved research project. If the investigator later wishes to use the data in a new project, a new proposal must be submitted. Use of data for purposes not expressly authorized by the approved research project constitutes a breach of the agreement.
* Investigators must agree to keep the individual patient data confidential. The data may only be shared within the team conducting the analysis project. Requests from other individuals for access to the data must be refused and referred to the COG.
* The regulatory requirements discussed in the Regulatory Considerations section of the COG Data Sharing Policy must be met.
* In situations where a complex data set is required, a fee may be charged.
* Copies of all manuscripts arising from the project associated with the data request must be sent to COG for review. However, approval of the manuscript is not a condition for use of the data.
* If the data are being provided for a project being conducted by a COG investigator, then all other relevant COG Group policies apply, particularly those relating to authorship and review of abstracts and manuscripts. If the data are being provided for an independent (non-COG) project, then there is no expectation that members of COG have authorship, unless COG members have made substantial contributions to the project.
* Release of data collected in a clinical trial conducted under a binding collaborative agreement between the NCI Cancer Therapy Evaluation Program (CTEP) and a pharmaceutical/Biotechnology Company must be in compliance with the terms of the binding collaborative agreement and must be approved by CTEP and the company. Release of the data is also subject to the terms of any contracts between COG and other entities, which cover any of the requested data.
* In releasing the data, COG makes no representations and extends no warranties of any kind, either expressed or implied. There are no expressed or implied warranties of merchantability or fitness for a particular purpose, or that the use of the data will not infringe any patent, copyright, trademark, or other proprietary rights. No indemnification for any loss, claim, damage, or liability will be intended or provided.
* Under no circumstances will any of the 18 identifiers delineated in the HIPAA privacy rule be provided (the complete list can be found at http://privacyruleandresearch.nih.gov/pr_08.asp). Dates, including dates of birth, diagnosis, registration, enrollment, treatment failure, death, etc. are considered identifiers and will not be provided. Instead time intervals required for analysis will be provided.

For all data sharing with investigators who are not members of COG, a project-specific identifier which is not the patient's COG identifier will be provided which identifies the research subject. The COG Statistics & Data Center will maintain the record of the patient's COG identifier and the project-specific identifier.

## C. APPEALS PROCESS
If a request for data is denied, the applicant may appeal the decision. The appeal will be reviewed by the COG Group Chair, NCI/CTEP's program officer and an outside statistician (i.e., a statistician that does not work for COG). The outside statistician will be named jointly by the COG Group Chair and the NCI/CTEP program officer.

DATA REQUEST PROCEDURE Consistent with the policies of the National Institutes of Health, COG considers requests from investigators who are not members of COG and to make its research data available to them. Investigators who wish to use individual patient data from one or more COG studies must make a formal request to the Group. The formal request must be in the form of a brief proposal as outlined below. The Group will then review the scientific merits and feasibility of the request. Note: Requests for data will ordinarily be considered once the primary study analyses have been published. Nevertheless, consideration of requests for data will be entertained in the event that there are long delays in the publication of the primary study data. The following information must be provided for requests for data from completed COG protocol research. The proposal must be no more the 5 pages. Proposals longer than 5 pages will be returned un-reviewed. 1) Title of research proposal 2) Project principal investigator(s), and contact information: address, phone number, e-mail address 3) COG protocol(s) from which project data is being requested 4) Project primary and secondary objectives 5) Description of the project's importance: what is to be learned from the research proposed to be performed using the data requested? 6) Description of the data elements requested and how these data will be used to address the primary and secondary objectives of the research 7) Brief description of how the project will be conducted 8) Description of funding plan for the project to include time and effort allocations for the Study Development Office and Statistics & Data Center 9) List of cases that are to be included in the dataset (e.g., list the study numbers), including what data items are required and descriptions of any exclusion restrictions Requests for access to COG protocol research data should be sent to: mailto:datarequest@childrensoncologygroup.org The Group will conduct an internal review of the merit and feasibility of the proposal, including whether there are sufficient data to provide adequate information for analysis and if the required data are available. Investigators will be notified of the Group's decisions in writing within 6 weeks of receipt. If a request is denied, COG, in the written decision, will provide the reasons the request was denied and inform the investigators that a denied request may be appealed as outlined in the appeals process section below. Release of the data is subject to the conditions outlined in release conditions below. B. RELEASE CONDITIONS & DISCLAIMER Release of data for research purposes is subject to the following conditions. A formal Data Use Agreement (DUA) covering the relevant conditions will usually be required. Investigators must agree to use the data only for the approved research project. If the investigator later wishes to use the data in a new project, a new proposal must be submitted. Use of data for purposes not expressly authorized by the approved research project constitutes a breach of the agreement. Investigators must agree to keep the individual patient data confidential. The data may only be shared within the team conducting the analysis project. Requests from other individuals for access to the data must be refused and referred to the COG. The regulatory requirements discussed in the Regulatory Considerations section of the COG Data Sharing Policy must be met. In situations where a complex data set is required, a fee may be charged. Copies of all manuscripts arising from the project associated with the data request must be sent to COG for review. However, approval of the manuscript is not a condition for use of the data. If the data are being provided for a project being conducted by a COG investigator, then all other relevant COG Group policies apply, particularly those relating to authorship and review of abstracts and manuscripts. If the data are being provided for an independent (non-COG) project, then there is no expectation that members of COG have authorship, unless COG members have made substantial contributions to the project. Release of data collected in a clinical trial conducted under a binding collaborative agreement between the NCI Cancer Therapy Evaluation Program (CTEP) and a pharmaceutical/Biotechnology Company must be in compliance with the terms of the binding collaborative agreement and must be approved by CTEP and the company. Release of the data is also subject to the terms of any contracts between COG and other entities, which cover any of the requested data. In releasing the data, COG makes no representations and extends no warranties of any kind, either expressed or implied. There are no expressed or implied warranties of merchantability or fitness for a particular purpose, or that the use of the data will not infringe any patent, copyright, trademark, or other proprietary rights. No indemnification for any loss, claim, damage, or liability will be intended or provided. Under no circumstances will any of the 18 identifiers delineated in the HIPAA privacy rule be provided (the complete list can be found at ). Dates, including dates of birth, diagnosis, registration, enrollment, treatment failure, death, etc. are considered identifiers and will not be provided. Instead time intervals required for analysis will be provided. For all data sharing with investigators who are not members of COG, a project-specific identifier which is not the patient's COG identifier will be provided which identifies the research subject. The COG Statistics & Data Center will maintain the record of the patient's COG identifier and the project-specific identifier. C. APPEALS PROCESS If a request for data is denied, the applicant may appeal the decision. The appeal will be reviewed by the COG Group Chair, NCI/CTEP's program officer and an outside statistician (i.e., a statistician that does not work for COG). The outside statistician will be named jointly by the COG Group Chair and the NCI/CTEP program officer. # Op-Ed: New Gun Law Mocks SCOTUS Decision
By Rob Ortt
---
| In the wake of Albany Democrats' most recent trampling of New Yorker's second amendments rights, we witnessed a heroic act in Greenwood, Indiana, that highlighted just how disastrous and nonsensical the latest anti-constitutional gun laws passed really are. Thanks to the bravery, skill and quick actions of a concealed carry permit holder, several lives inside the Greenwood Mall were saved on July 17th.
While we pray for the families of those who lost loved ones on that day, we also recognize the lives that were saved due to a civilian's ability to respond quickly and neutralize a threat, thanks to his ability to use a concealed pistol.
Unfortunately, because of the recently passed laws in New York, the hero who saved lives would be considered a felon if an incident such as this happened later this year. Not only will these new laws make it more difficult for law-abiding pistol permit holders to exercise their constitutional right, they would criminalize the right to self-defense.
America is home to over 18 million concealed carry permit holders. Yet over the last 18 years, less than 0.8% of all firearm-related homicides in the U.S. have involved law-abiding concealed carry permit holders. Law-abiding pistol permit holders are not the ones committing crimes. An overwhelming majority of the gun violence and gun-related homicides we witness daily are perpetrated by criminals with illegal firearms. These are the same criminals who are being arrested and quickly released back on our streets thanks to Albany Democrats' pro-criminal policies like bail reform. In New York, these lawbreakers are re-committing violent crimes at over four times the rate of law-abiding pistol permit holders. After SCOTUS ruled New York's existing pistol permit process unconstitutional, Governor Kathy Hochul and her anti-protection allies in the State Legislature were quick to orchestrate a "Special Session" to condemn and harass law-abiding pistol permit holders. Yet it's these same politicians who continue to sit idly by as violent crime skyrockets; there is no accountability for those criminals breaking the law.
Instead of doubling down on their unconstitutional policies of the past and passing unconstitutional laws that will do absolutely nothing to address gun violence, New York State should instead be empowering all New Yorkers, regardless of sex, race, religion, or political persuasion, to exercise their constitutional rights to self-defense and self-preservation.
The right to self-defense and the second amendment is not limited to an individual's home. I hope the court system in New York sees these new pistol permit laws for what they are, a mockery of the U.S. Supreme Court's ruling, and strikes down this nonsensical legislation. Multiple lawsuits have already been filed in New York to do just that. I pray, God forbid we see a horrible tragedy such as the one we witnessed in Indiana here in New York, that a brave, upstanding citizen with a concealed carry permit will be there to protect and save innocent lives. ##

New Hampshire doesn't do landslides, team.

Nate Silver's _FiveThirtyEight_ called New Hampshire “one of the swingiest electorates in the country,” and they're not wrong.
In 2016, I unseated a Republican incumbent by a razor-thin 1,017 votes.

In 2020, Joe Biden won this state by a single-digit margin – but New Hampshire Republicans flipped both chambers of the state legislature and reelected a Republican governor.
**Now, in 2022, political experts are calling this seat one of the most likely to flip.**
This battleground state has a long history of tight races, and with Democrats facing the most difficult national environment in decades, New Hampshire is the number one target for control of the Senate.
**[_That's why we need an army of grassroots supporters behind us every step of the way._](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48676212/359172646/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1349-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZTc1NmJhZC03ODEyLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cemppf8h2qfZA0KFE8b2lCVkk6FJB973GFT-_hz6Eec=)**

subject: Trump is coming to Wisconsin
body:
Derek,
Recently we found out that it’s official: Trump is coming to Wisconsin to campaign for his pick to replace me.
That means he’s going to attack me and my record as governor as he tries to make sure his pick wins the primary.
We know facts don’t matter to Trump - he’s going to lie about my record. That is why we have to make sure we’re ready to respond before he takes the stage.
Can you split a donation of $25 or more between my campaign and CommonGood before Trump's visit so that we’ve got what it takes to respond to whatever attacks he and his allies launch? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2022_evers?refcode=CGVA_20220802_Evers]
Trump’s pick for governor has refused to rule out overturning the 2020 election results in Wisconsin and during the latest debate he called to cut funding for our schools.
We can’t let Trump and his pick win.
That is why I am asking personally, Derek:
Can you click here and chip in before it's too late? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2022_evers?refcode=CGVA_20220802_Evers]

---
**Peter,** Last night, the first female Lt. Gov. of Virginia, Winsome Earle-Sears hosted a phenomenal fundraiser for me right here in Virginia’s 8th District!I am so honored that such an accomplished, fellow immigrant, traveled to my District to show her support. What an amazing night!
| [SIGN UP HERE TO LEARN ABOUT MORE EVENTS LIKE THIS!](https://karinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5169078bc3370360935103e65&id=95861701a6&e=22db41c18e)

| [JOIN THE MOMENTUM AND GIVE $100 TODAY!](https://karinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5169078bc3370360935103e65&id=0756179a1b&e=22db41c18e)
---
Lieutenant Governor Sears understands the powerful experience of immigrants who want nothing more than to come to the United States to thrive and prosper.My campaign is one about hope and passion for the American Dream, and I’m glad to have supporters from McLean to Alexandria to Fort Hunt who are ready to see change come to our communities.
# ENDORSEMENT ALERT!
Maggie’s List officially endorsed my campaign today! I’m honored to have received their confidence and support in my fight to bring common sense principles and sound economics to Washington!“Karina is the embodiment of the American Dream, and I can think of no one better to represent Virginia’s 8th District in Congress,” said Maggie’s List Virginia Co-Chair and Spokesperson Tina Ramirez. “She espouses the Maggie’s List values of strong national security, limited government and fiscal responsibility and we are proud to support her election effort this fall,” Ramirez continued.
# UPCOMING EVENTS
Here is a list of what’s going on over the next few weeks! Save your spot today and come say hello!**August 3:** Come meet Karina at the Mt. Vernon Farmers’ Market in Alexandria at 10am!**August 3:** Join Karina at the Leonadus K. Plenty Amphitheater at Lee District Park in Franconia to celebrate the talents of Pablo Perez in his salsa showcase “El Alcalde de la Salsa” at 7:30pm! No RSVP required, show up with a passion for the arts and any questions you might have for Karina! **August 4:** Come meet Karina at the Annandale Farmers’ Market (6621 Columbia Pike) at 10am!**August 4:** Falls Church Meet & Greet Happy Hour at the home of Rachel and Corey Neal! To attend, email [RSVP@KarinaForCongress.com](mailto:RSVP@KarinaForCongress.com), subject “August 4 Falls Church Meet and Greet.”**August 5:** Come meet Karina at the Kingstowne Farmers’ Market in Alexandria (5870 Kingstowne Center) from 3pm to 7pm!***August 8:** Republican Party of Virginia (RPV) Chairman Rich Anderson hosts meet & greet fundraiser for the Southern Tier of VA08! Location and details pending. Email [RSVP@KarinaForCongress.com](mailto:RSVP@KarinaForCongress.com), subject “RPV Event” for details.* **August 11:** Latinos for Karina Happy Hour – 6:00-7:30pm at Los Chamacos, 922 South Walter Reed Drive, Arlington, VA 22204 – email [LatinosPorKarina@gmail.com](mailto:LatinosForKarina@gmail.com) to RSVP and receive more info on how to join the momentum!*****August 25:** First Lady of Virginia, Suzanne Youngkin to host special VIP fundraiser for Karina. Details pending. Email [RSVP@KarinaForCongress.com](mailto:RSVP@KarinaForCongress.com), subject “SY Event” for details.***
| [BRING COMMON SENSE BACK TO NOVA BY DONATING $50 TODAY! ](https://karinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5169078bc3370360935103e65&id=eb5b6c54f7&e=22db41c18e)
---
# CALL FOR VOLUNTEERS!
Join our Volunteer Kickoff at Karina for Congress HQ at 225 S. Henry Street in Alexandria on Saturday morning at 9:00am. Email [volunteer@karinaforcongress.com](mailto:volunteer@karinaforcongress.com) with any questions!Let’s bring common sense back to Washington this November!KarinaPS — Did you catch me on Larry O’Connor on WMAL this week? name: Citizens for Turner
subject: Mike Turner Delivers for Dayton!
body:
| | | | | |
---
| | | | Friends, I wanted to make sure you saw this – the House recently passed the National Defense Authorization Act, and I was glad to secure many victories for our country and the Miami Valley. For our country and those who serve in our military:
* **Increased pay of our men and women in uniform to combat inflation**
* **Established a Servicemember Parent’s Bill of Rights**
* **Increased Biden’s inadequate defense budget by $37 billion**
* **Expanded mental health services and suicide prevention programs**

For our Dayton community:
* **Authorized $29 million for a School Age Child Care Center at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base**
* **Reauthorized the Small Business Innovation Research Program through 2024**
* **Established a program within the Department of Defense to increase STEM research funding at Central State University and Wilberforce University here in Ohio, as well as other Historically Black Colleges and Universities.**

---
| | | | | [KEEP IT UP MIKE!](https://click.icptrack.com/icp/relay.php?r=126057447&msgid=1014812&act=NE1B&c=493811&pid=12535488&destination=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Fturner%2Fsupport-mike-turner&cf=64880&v=a9bc398e9f07d9ae65eac8dfeb29126d428ae43df52345c5c3fbf5aec4fa5284)
---
| | | | The passage of this legislation establishes our nation’s defense priorities and makes critical investments in our military. Expanding operations at Wright-Patterson strengthens Dayton’s defense industry and grows our local economy. I will continue to advocate for investment in our military and Wright-Patt, ensuring they have the resources they need to protect your family and our country. Sincerely, Congressman Michael R. Turner
---

body:
[](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6ff7e179bd5f488daf8ae21b38aa2cb4&_e=ctBymdtNfjgO_xUB2Ly-D5y_BitoJ1mXZ4MHOoewstrfba1gL6eaeiORi3mt4sMIzpp1nG4sqQh0CNZhGrg22N0AWSxUMDkek4FSNzlaOO53rKRMN8QCp2l2Y60IbB59jCW5AG_4bypoY0-HdbSlcOnWdn1t44t2kSptNbaWB9CR6OnXylHBwAf1R3lJDMsQH_rlSiqSjLqUvGriow9PiJsak7pq3hwhwjOI5TyPiodl2bQ0sBX65gj3aVRaeW3iijjeh7SiMeUA6BWMdV6eNesDMBZvy2wQcjZBalYpbVOpPB9ZoWm7bpsC7NLh-7qKeK-nWIXZZhgs18G0LrjHEEiT67o-FgbNuby2mEwnCO0%3D)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America’s black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation’s mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6ff7e179bd5f488daf8ae21b38aa2cb4&_e=ctBymdtNfjgO_xUB2Ly-D5y_BitoJ1mXZ4MHOoewstrfba1gL6eaeiORi3mt4sMIzpp1nG4sqQh0CNZhGrg22N0AWSxUMDkek4FSNzlaOO53rKRMN8QCp2l2Y60IbB59jCW5AG_4bypoY0-HdbSlcBSooxjFHpGYqHhFZq5GUKUXg9RD6pZoE6Cu8U62JQW89o7SLt-mDMfizy81Fxj05LP4_o4pqvyr8us0c2D4UwYmxfYLzif22IAjUdwkfd6YAnQGFY_kuVFMiE-Zn5S8CNUVFeCtDSyWIiSoASAbW-A-tiABeUhEXJ1g8eSAiJjTmtRkJ7lJGOlWI_8B2bxgke69SxFnekEENfdox7QUGY0%3D)

**_Now I’ll share my story_ ... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how “helpless” I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We’re taught to believe we’re victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I’ve dealt with racism... _**I’ve even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Friend, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6ff7e179bd5f488daf8ae21b38aa2cb4&_e=ctBymdtNfjgO_xUB2Ly-D5y_BitoJ1mXZ4MHOoewstrfba1gL6eaeiORi3mt4sMIzpp1nG4sqQh0CNZhGrg22N0AWSxUMDkek4FSNzlaOO53rKRMN8QCp2l2Y60IbB59jCW5AG_4bypoY0-HdbSlcBt1yq7ixag97Dc_e46YFxDORdasUQLWd2hl4yPaGZh_zzFwVfUygQeAcogmJfM2zURlM18RTYgKi0IhSVCMglSwrr5ezT4Rd4jHfVCZdAv210vAYqrRwDTlL8fBqV8GzdR-4OSi71SgDt9g-o5uBdUSJZWfsIGIyFdUwiKWlri1c_nONlApUZVa12BkxvKjYLSDxNKxVsCnyg1ykSg3joM%3D)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I’m not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don’t want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a “think tank”, but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting “DO-tank”. We’re doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation’s values, what we’re doing to reach Black communities, and what we’re fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly “fighting for minorities” are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT’s efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6ff7e179bd5f488daf8ae21b38aa2cb4&_e=ctBymdtNfjgO_xUB2Ly-D5y_BitoJ1mXZ4MHOoewstrfba1gL6eaeiORi3mt4sMIzpp1nG4sqQh0CNZhGrg22N0AWSxUMDkek4FSNzlaOO53rKRMN8QCp2l2Y60IbB59jCW5AG_4bypoY0-HdbSlcDu87cY6r69AYvqUtF8CENA_QU9KcjrtPbeDCJDn0ZbEbrosa5mf-_0fC-l_gjS4H01-LTycrxWAFQmHkiDG5bAPYNce2NDibLMby7HfpcnIeKBTDLBoRcN6QflDro6irFg_vGb-xkQywGEgvdpjhlq2mtiDaWzlE5zF_T-Q70gs4E7Z7epJlDMvPbQJhJVKNkr_c37hj-flFNLNoAoRSBY%3D)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6ff7e179bd5f488daf8ae21b38aa2cb4&_e=ctBymdtNfjgO_xUB2Ly-D5y_BitoJ1mXZ4MHOoewstrfba1gL6eaeiORi3mt4sMIzpp1nG4sqQh0CNZhGrg22N0AWSxUMDkek4FSNzlaOO53rKRMN8QCp2l2Y60IbB59jCW5AG_4bypoY0-HdbSlcPyu-k_t_MGA651KLvINfWRx0nMGBiyrI0cho8xUO_NVcIrz8604F-vWt5Pld2j-DO3hzwTNICqN18sFpPVq7LjQjDMu6ne6aEAr4Pb3JCzGH46J3QEVKJSXWWult1DyrhgW4gbXYb2-G-TtZ8Ovfx8JmByIExRnIR7plx0yN46BFX2iuLQsHBlb__jf7KuMQCH22hSE4KKkChXhKqeSSXY%3D)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we’re actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6ff7e179bd5f488daf8ae21b38aa2cb4&_e=ctBymdtNfjgO_xUB2Ly-D5y_BitoJ1mXZ4MHOoewstrfba1gL6eaeiORi3mt4sMIzpp1nG4sqQh0CNZhGrg22N0AWSxUMDkek4FSNzlaOO53rKRMN8QCp2l2Y60IbB59jCW5AG_4bypoY0-HdbSlcO3_qS9ZcLF69732SxHhTYFqB1UP2s89h0786x3-4Z3YkW6Kt0E8_Lrx_suwv_tR7QJydNkA_iLibVmKX0FDD7uS8NMasNo0zbqqbfZz-yl3fuOyljq3FK8u2svKeBd7_RsUXwMPwPQgrJiP2QqftACtaGAwEanMk1iGqksQ6yxbt4eVA-pyYRKnZMExBmm_NNUFCAJCMaAzjuLVCHhh3Jw%3D)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6ff7e179bd5f488daf8ae21b38aa2cb4&_e=ctBymdtNfjgO_xUB2Ly-D5y_BitoJ1mXZ4MHOoewstrfba1gL6eaeiORi3mt4sMIzpp1nG4sqQh0CNZhGrg22N0AWSxUMDkek4FSNzlaOO53rKRMN8QCp2l2Y60IbB59jCW5AG_4bypoY0-HdbSlcCcIXt8T3wOGi7RgU2K0SwQssNxI3hcs6bE4891IdMqp_BrBFuntsTPlaSKQOe6vlZrBZqfke-CPdhSdLQ3jx2-aIHU_LW8I3zbMuQw3xJD_HF3nQubk9p7vE5A9j9puxiChmX48QBTeLOHXHsSI6R4iOnKN8JUqwm5tvW_zXK3dmva99hg17vCKZFGJurYiF-WAjWRHlflrZHZP6xa2wZs%3D)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we’ve allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We’re hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We’re not just preaching to the choir, and these aren’t boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT’s events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6ff7e179bd5f488daf8ae21b38aa2cb4&_e=ctBymdtNfjgO_xUB2Ly-D5y_BitoJ1mXZ4MHOoewstrfba1gL6eaeiORi3mt4sMIzpp1nG4sqQh0CNZhGrg22N0AWSxUMDkek4FSNzlaOO53rKRMN8QCp2l2Y60IbB59jCW5AG_4bypoY0-HdbSlcC1TLs_tUsG5M1MkQTuXBjXX09P5tuQMV8PEoGa-JgFvqcWby5DoZruWp_0QBSwqFjWR64P8arU-Z_lYXLvIfwB9QC6v5N7F-UgbLYQ5YIbMXkOz8IcZv0JGjd7LaNwKFi6aG2WmdxC_QgxovNzmPWWNepfTCd4yObowmMBBY-220DWJJHBTm3D8Yv7ulhHo9-zCZiopAKO6_3pLkpRYPXk%3D)

What does “BLEXIT” mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

This is personal to me.

I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot.

clean_body: Friend, This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation. Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation. For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop. In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities. Our message to America’s black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture. Now I’ll share my story ... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities. Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how “helpless” I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking. We’re taught to believe we’re victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals. This is WRONG. I’ve dealt with racism... I’ve even received death threats. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable. But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up. I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters. I am breaking the rules. It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... I’m not doing that. You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country. So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don’t want to miss). When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a “think tank”, but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting “DO-tank”. We’re doing things no other organization in the country is doing. Here are the BLEXIT Foundation’s values, what we’re doing to reach Black communities, and what we’re fighting for: School Choice: Often, the people allegedly “fighting for minorities” are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools. The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. Criminal Justice Reform: The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities. Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message. Entrepreneurship: I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire. BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we’re actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we’ve allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore. The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We’re hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We’re not just preaching to the choir, and these aren’t boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. What does “BLEXIT” mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor. This is personal to me. I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot. Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I’ve copied below to donate today: This is my last message to you before you close this email. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment. My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause. Thank you, Friend. Candace Owens President BLEXIT Foundation Sent to Conservative Liberty Wire subscribers. 625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314

body:
I answered a call to serve because I loved my community and wanted to protect it from harm
| | |
---
Friend, Marco Rubio is attacking my 27 years of law enforcement service, so I'm reaching out to set the record straight.

Back in 1983, **I answered a call to serve because I loved my community and wanted to protect it from harm.** And while I was working the midnight shift, Marco Rubio was plotting his trajectory as a career politician.

But the problem is that some voters have only heard Marco Rubio's lies about me, and I need the resources to share my story of service with more Floridians before it's too late. Please understand, friend: How quickly I'm able to correct the record for voters will make or break this election.

**[If you can spare $5, will you donate before midnight to help me counter Rubio's attacks?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48684226/359192093/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3920-fr-nd&recurring=0&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YjAzNGU5MS04NDEyLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=A0DN5uvF1snO2HPvHmXOKEI5dQRY15RlQVJbpelt0VM=)**

Friend, Let me tell you a story: **** On Halloween 2017, I rushed my infant daughter to the emergency room. When I arrived, I soon learned she had [autoimmune hemolytic anemia](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/ZsYp6Jc2ATNP3MkVzvte6NUDhqOcWaPiUnFUVITe78wWmFXNakK190ExuLvBsmjos2PjmG00HWflfaWB8dLDYk3zcDcLRDwmMx8y1cE5QeIY5v6jvZtfZYkRAh4a3XKyqIkBEzSPXHqoFKImoTFqDJg50ibBzUL3pT-3JzXpPoujFX6hyvzYo88xmF_2qjFlyKQC-KltxuHwmoUcqehcvvufntsyKTc8WB2eftt0JPW-XDlCb1oMIrT3K2meJnBWvBU0Ytoj79ktkFN7rQETHfFEvCH8Kv_iwGlkgk1-o_BQvSMUiZbAUeTUG4nA7LMA/3o9/hiURmkHjQAaeQw53Lfz0xw/h1/APteEXqrEv1Rd_Wj_y3L-ymcJMJBeUrwuFR6rfgXTXM), a rare blood disorder. **** Before I even got to the hospital, my first phone call from the ambulance was to my insurance company. **** That fact haunts me even today. I should have been focusing on whether my baby was okay. Instead, I was forced to jump through hoops to save my family from medical bankruptcy.
---

Summer temperatures in Arizona can reach highs of over 110 degrees creating dangerous conditions for U.S. Postal Service employees who deliver our mail. Today, fewer than a fifth of USPS vehicles in Arizona have air conditioning. Hot outside temperatures coupled with the inability to avoid the heat during a shift and temperatures inside postal vehicles climbing much higher than outside, can lead to serious health consequences for USPS workers. Kyrsten held a hearing in Phoenix to address the dangers of hot vehicles for U.S. Postal Service employees, highlighting that some USPS employees in parts of the country have died from exposure to extreme heat. body:
The stakes have never been greater | | |
---
| | Good morning Freedom Fighters,

There is a lot on the line this Election Day and _today is your last chance to vote in the August 2 nd primary election_. If you don’t know where to vote in person, please visit this [website](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=fd842f415a&e=a7ab36849c) to find the closest polling place. Please be sure to bring a valid government issued ID to the polls.

When you are marking off your ballot, you need to ask yourself what qualities you would like in your next Secretary of State who will oversee the 2024 presidential election. When you elect me, you know you will have these distinct qualities:
* Someone who checks her politics at the door, but not her conservative principles
* A strong leader who will stand up and fight for what is right, while pushing back against federal overreach
* A customer service-oriented office that works for the people of this state
* A chief election official that writes an Election Procedures Manual void of one’s political party’s policy preferences, only Arizona’s state statutes

It has been an absolute pleasure getting to know so many amazing Arizonans since I first announced at the end of last June. I’m truly grateful for the new friendships I have made and your unwavering support of my candidacy.

For Arizona,
---

| Shawnna Bolick

name: Marco Rubio
subject: Humbly asking you to read this
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Marco Rubio for Senate
body:
I’d like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6216%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=8uOsuuzh%2fTztQk%2bOobGuAQ&sysid=1)
I’d like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out.

|
---
| | | Friend,

I’d like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I’ve been emailing, texting, and calling more than normal right now, but I need to reach my goal by midnight and need you to listen to me.

I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I’d take a second to walk you through why I’m running for office and why this deadline means so much.

---
| [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64049%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=EM%2bY1X%2bHc2d8lAWKH7JVLg&sysid=1)
---

This is a photo of my dad (of course wearing a Miami Dolphins shirt). He was the best role model for being a father, a friend, and an American.

He and my mom thankfully came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream.

---
| [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64040%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=qImcGV%2feZyew3p4xgTB1CQ&sysid=1)
---

Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated.

I met my wife Jeanette through mutual friends and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64041%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=3lmcmcQ056o7kHgbrvB6vg&sysid=1)
---

All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden’s policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that’s exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I’m teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

---
| [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64042%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ThtiEZJwtFqDbxV%2bofdnQQ&sysid=1)
---

After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn’t have been more grateful for their support.

I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream.

---
| [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64043%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=VhJMcseesQcVs7X1Znm3rw&sysid=1)
---

This brings me to my main point: I’m running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream.

I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from.

Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real. **If we’re outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream.**
**[I hope you’ll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64044%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=lVZUFTA7XNISDVU%2fd0LSOg&sysid=1)**
---
| | | [I'LL JOIN YOU, MARCO!](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64155%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=XLTmUWckMrRjgfSs9W7ojw&sysid=1)
---
Thank you so much for taking the time to read this,

Marco Rubio
---
| | | | |
* * *
---
| [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64156%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=5WNVYdbWWTwm%2bt4Eh%2fM0Pw&sysid=1)
---
I talk to folks every day who say they haven’t donated because they think they need to write a big check or they think my race isn’t close.

Well, let me tell you, this race will be decided on a razor-thin margin. Currently, we’re only separated by 2%, but considering the MILLIONS my opponent is raising, she could easily take the lead after smearing me in new campaign ads.

With such a tight race, any amount donated today can make a difference.

**[Please, can you give $4, 8, $12.55, or $17 today?](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64157%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=KUi7upvtk8zuEpfruMtTCQ&sysid=1)**

name: Marco Rubio
subject: Humbly asking you to read this
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Marco Rubio for Senate
body:
I’d like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zih57gv6h0rciotpggv7osnc64b8lpp0203uepkg_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk4qj4ttkumqn4s9nmorb79hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4onke5gb2tb6emr32sb0m9pj6p5ic1g6cs5ks1pb8ptgm2rmasb3c8qrddbleji31puie1p64pjgm9j71p5jcdg74cb6elgbbdhnmapmcc9gm9j61o5lcdge1d9h66qj3dbi46h22sh2s8i66pb4s5hmcoj6cdh2bs)

|
---
| | | Friend,

I'd like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I've been emailing, texting, and calling more than normal right now, but I need to reach my goal by midnight and need you to listen to me.

I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I'd take a second to walk you through why I'm running for office and why this deadline means so much.

---
| [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zg14t2mhcronqnp4fmdolkbs90qlk9nlah6lps68_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5hmcoj6cdh2bs "2")
---

This is a photo of my dad (of course wearing a Miami Dolphins shirt). He was the best role model for being a father, a friend, and an American.

He and my mom thankfully came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream.

---
| [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zfdhtc2u4ng02dtndghlqqipku2p1quqo17ghkq8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5hmcoj6cdh2bs "1")
---

Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated.

I met my wife Jeanette through mutual friends and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2znlbjk4vpgdmemfg7ljnldsforcfq874gc2vcb0o_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5hmcoj6cdh2bs "3")
---

All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden's policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that's exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I'm teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

---
| [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zb6amu9gqafrvfk8ph7q0161dhplau622hfcuht0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5hmcoj6cdh2bs "4")
---

After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn't have been more grateful for their support.

We can’t win without all of the little pieces in place - and if we’re going to get the resources we need, we have to count on grassroots conservatives like YOU, Peter. _**A Revolution Is Coming in Heart-Disease Treatment**_ By Bobby Jindal and Neil M. Gheewala
---
A cancer-care revolution that started in the 1980s is spreading to cardiac care. In the 1980s, cancer was treated almost exclusively in hospital settings. These days, more than 80% of all cancer care happens in community outpatient centers, which achieve better outcomes, keep costs low, and offer a more agreeable environment to both patients and caregivers. Heart disease is poised for a similar revolution, with the potential to have an enormous positive effect on the U.S. healthcare system. Cardiovascular disease already... A cancer-care revolution that started in the 1980s is spreading to cardiac care. In the 1980s, cancer was treated almost exclusively in hospital settings. These days, more than 80% of all cancer care happens in community outpatient centers, which achieve better outcomes, keep costs low, and offer a more agreeable environment to both patients and caregivers. Heart disease is poised for a similar revolution, with the potential to have an enormous positive effect on the U.S. healthcare system. Cardiovascular disease already accounts for 1 out of 7 healthcare dollars spent, and the total cost is expected to double and then some, to $1.1 trillion by 2035. Advances in cardiovascular medicine are creating a shift toward preventive care, shorter hospital stays, lower costs and better outcomes. The Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services recently approved 14 new reimbursement codes for outpatient ambulatory surgical centers, or ASCs, with more codes likely to be approved in the coming years. The reimbursement rates for these new codes are an average of 50% cheaper for ASCs than they are for hospital outpatient departments. In addition to significant savings for payers, patients will benefit from fewer physician visits, same-day treatments and better outcomes. (We are both board members, and Dr. Gheewala is a staff member, of a company that owns an ASC and has two more under development.) Medicare has paid hospital outpatient departments nearly twice as much as it pays independent physicians or ASCs for the same services. Even off-campus facilities, which are hospital-owned but otherwise identical to independent physicians, have until recently enjoyed higher rates. Making payments site-neutral and shifting more services to outpatient settings would reduce Medicare spending by more than $150 billion in the next decade. It would reduce beneficiary spending on premiums and cost sharing by more than $90 billion over that time. Moving patient care to outpatient settings will require new investments in information technology and billing systems as well as record-keeping and care protocols. Hospitals claim they need higher margins to compensate for costly, complicated cases and to subsidize other departments, but the accounting to support these claims is often opaque. Indirect subsidies are inefficient and subject to manipulation. They have led to a lack of price transparency and large cost variability. It would be better to replace these subsidies with targeted direct payments for outlier patients with more complications and unprofitable services such as pediatrics. Cardiovascular physicians will have to do what oncologists did—invest millions in new facilities, treatment protocols and patient-outcome monitoring systems. The expense and complexity of this undertaking might drive cardiologists to aggregate into larger groups. The resulting economies of scale would strengthen their negotiating hand with payers and help them secure favorable financing for new buildings and technology. More than 80% of the nation’s cardiologists currently work for integrated health systems, and the largest independent practices have fewer than 100 physicians. Many doctors will welcome an alternative to the bureaucratic, misaligned hospital-employed model. They’ll love not being treated like assembly-line workers trapped in logistical labyrinths. Cardiovascular physicians who derive a significant portion of their income from services like imaging tests will have to be careful. So-called Stark laws prohibit self-referrals. Doctors will need to guard against this by adopting compensation protocols and other compliance safeguards. The main obstacle to the transformation of heart healthcare isn’t medical but political. Despite moves by CMS to encourage outpatient care and site-neutral payments, many states either ban certain cardiac procedures outside hospitals or require certificates of need for new ASCs. California, New York, Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Virginia and Massachusetts limit many procedures to hospitals, while North Carolina, Tennessee, Illinois and Washington require certificates of need. There has been incremental movement toward competition and freedom. Michigan and Mississippi recently moved to allow procedures in ASCs that obtain a certificate of need. State legislators need to update their laws to keep up with modern medical practices. Regulatory capture isn’t unique to healthcare, but it imposes both financial and medical costs on patients. Cardiac care is on the cusp of a major transformation, but hospitals need not be left behind. They can forge symbiotic partnerships with cardiovascular groups that allow them to secure referrals without the financial and management burdens of owning the practices. Heart patients will benefit most, but only if lawmakers have the courage to take on entrenched interests.

body:
Arizona needs an AG with skin in the game

## August 2, 2022
|
| | |
---|---|---
| When Biden took office, Cartel violence, illegal immigration, and drug smuggling exploded in my community. My family lives in the middle of three Cartel smuggling routes. My kids, our fourth-generation family farm, and our small businesses are under threat directly because of Joe Biden’s radical open border agenda. I chose to run for Attorney General to implement solutions, not just for my home, my community, my kids, and my business, but yours as well. **Today is your last chance to vote.** Today is your last chance to choose who will go to bat for you when Biden’s schemes and agendas come for your livelihoods and rights. Today is your last chance to decide who will keep a watchful eye on our state, punish election fraud, protect our water and natural resources, and go to war with the Cartels. If we choose a weak, unprepared politician to be our next Attorney General, we’re going to suffer. Vote for me, I’ll put my expertise as an attorney, natural resource and water expert, small business owner, and conservative fighter to use for Arizonans every day. The problems that face Arizona aren’t messaging for me, they’re personal. Others talk but I walk the walk. After a lifetime of working on the issues we face, you know that I will follow through. If you haven’t voted yet. Here’s your last chance. **HOW TO VOTE**
1. [Click here to find your local voting location](https://88783.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/4nwqAiSykTj7MMLdbM0s06cKoShawjqFGPv00_9P3l4gM3gEFGMgCJpsdrXDmgoqrfxgCoZYhk7O2DEZkzidzKgY3gh6w23wzaERHgE-nM7IGKlWxZBA2HgLJzK52zrqPEosMe10gQma44gWx0Q47tBwSWXYDhOFgGp6uNYKao7WKZzyvtkGR_8_baywGXKijbRCmA7net7Hy9BNNXpQjePocBDppRebZMjaQKGGlDw).
2. Bring your valid government issued ID (your Arizona driver’s license will work) that includes your name, photo, and voting address. If you are an early voter with a ballot, do not mail it in. Bring it to a voting location and hand it in there.
3. Vote for Tiffany Shedd for Attorney General!
4. If you live in Maricopa County, [click here to “Check Your Status” and track your ballot](https://88783.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/hYi5iTbxb9Ad6WcUSsk0PN8izmxszG41GMM5Al1TaMKPaOhsMUGCCMcJEghMQ1auzOIniDtHOcU-zDexG8wFi3BobnuKJIkaaA0VrEV59XWQ51SRoOe-MaXYeJBRHyigdjG7FDKKFA_8lTbDz78g5aSvgPIqWA6xYEA8M8bHHANUAil5pMIQiBOC7ZwuwptMnDyFScyqH-llE0tOq2roZrP97qEPuNepybn09sBx8A2Azxyq).

I want to thank every one of you for the support. This campaign was a massive group effort and I am blessed to have you part of our great team. Thank you for your continued support, |

| ,

When Arizonans are voting in November, will they have a conservative champion that went toe-to-toe with Mark Kelly? Today is Arizona Republicans’ last chance to decide who our nominee to overthrow Kelly and retake the U.S. Senate will be. I’m the only candidate in this race with a proven conservative track record and consistent statewide election wins. If you haven’t voted, help me get across the finish line today.

**If you know any conservative friends, family, or colleagues, reach out to them today and make sure they voted.**

If you haven’t voted yet, again, _this is your last chance_. Here’s how you can vote today.
---
| | **HOW TO VOTE**
1. [Click here to locate a voting location](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=95186d7664&e=6dcd2506d1).
2. If you are an early voter and have your ballot already, _do**not** mail it in_. Bring your ballot to your voting location and _hand it in_.
3. Bring a valid government issued ID card—like your Arizona driver’s license—that has your photograph, your voting address, and your name on it.
4. Vote for Mark Brnovich for the U.S. Senate!
5. It’s optional, but if you live in Maricopa County, you can [click here to “Check Your Status”](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=15d70f80b6&e=6dcd2506d1) to follow up on your ballot’s tracking and processing.

---
| I want to thank everyone for getting out and voting. The effort everyone has put into my campaign has been invaluable and inspiring. Not everyone puts their back into politics and saving our state, so you’re all true patriots in my book.

For Arizona,

| We're coming together to say thank you to our First Responders on Wednesday, August 17 from 6pm - 8:30pm at Dr. Scofflaw's @ The Works in West Midtown.
**We are very excited to be joined by Congressman Barry Loudermilk for this event!**
This event will be a reception followed by speaking from our special guests. We are also co-hosting with the Buckhead Young Republicans.

There will be many first responders present as well as foundations and organizations that support them. We want to give the community an opportunity to show our appreciation for what they do each day for us and find ways we can get more involved to support them.

We are looking for individuals willing to become a Host or Sponsor for this event to support our campaign for Congress. Please contact us at 404-360-7150 if you are interested.

See you there!

body:
I want to take a minute to explain why your contribution is so important to our campaign
| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/20456?t=6&akid=3948%2E878179%2EW0WMWY) Friends —

When it comes to emails, I’m probably a lot like you: Every day I get messages like this from campaigns asking for my support.

I understand it might be hard to see how just one contribution could make a difference in this campaign. That’s why I want to take a minute to explain why your $5 is so important.

As you know, our race will be one of the closest in the country. A recent poll had us down by 2%, and Donald Trump endorsed a GOP-extremist against me just a couple of weeks ago. National Republicans and outside groups have already spent millions attacking me, and with this news, you can be sure millions more are coming. We’re in for a tough fight — and that’s why your support is so critical right now.

When you make your first $5 contribution, that money will immediately be put to work to reach voters across Arizona.
