subject: Your August Campaign Update
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Nikki For Congress
body:
Friend, it’s Nikki.

I wanted to take a moment to thank you personally for your support in helping us reach our July fundraising goal. You are an integral part of this people-powered campaign, so from the bottom of my heart, thank you!

Our must-win election is now just a little over three months away , and I’ve been traveling all over the district spreading our campaign’s positive message and connecting with voters.

I wanted to take a moment to share what I’ve been up to with you, but if you’re short on time, I hope you’ll consider helping us start off August strong by making an $3 donation to my Democratic campaign right now » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mc_budzinski_q32022_df?amount=3]

$20,000 AUGUST GOAL: CHIP IN $3 NOW » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mc_budzinski_q32022_df?amount=3]

August Campaign Update

I am honored to be the Democratic nominee in IL-13. Working families in Central and Southern IL need a champion who will fight inflation, tackle the rising costs of gas and energy, and stand up for them. I’m ready to fight to turn this seat union blue in November.

I’ve toured all 7 counties in the district, met with community members from across Central and Southern Illinois, and I’m only just getting started.

Some highlights include the Chatham Sweet Corn Festival, attending the Athena dinner celebrating Illinois women in leadership, and joining Thomas Walker and First Lady Margaret Walker at her birthday party at Main Street Church of the Living God in Decatur.

I’m looking forward to continuing my time out on the campaign trail and meeting folks all across IL-13!

Chip in $3 to help me amplify my people-first message across IL-13 » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mc_budzinski_q32022_df?amount=3]

IL-13 is OFFICIALLY one of the most competitive districts in the entire country, so we have to keep our fundraising strong!

I’m up against a multi-millionaire heiress who is out of touch with the real issues impacting working people.
I’ve always advocated for working families, and I vow to do the same in Congress.

We need a major fundraising push to start off August strong, and I’m counting on grassroots supporters like you to help me do it.

Please, chip in $3 to keep this campaign firing on all cylinders and protect our slim Democratic majority » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mc_budzinski_q32022_df?amount=3]

Thank you for being part of our campaign. Now let’s flip this seat together.

Nikki Budzinski

body:

|
# House Republican Whip Steve Scalise
---
|
---
| | |
---|---
|
(August 1, 2022) Today, Erik Aadland, CD7 Republican candidate for Congress, announces a formal endorsement from House Republican Whip, Steve Scalise.

Congressman Steve Scalise represents the First Congressional District of Louisiana. He was elected to Congress in 2008 after serving in the Louisiana State Legislature from 1996-2008. He serves his colleagues as the House Republican Whip, the second highest position in House Republican leadership.

From the House repeal of Obamacare, to the reauthorization of the National Flood Insurance Program, to the largest pay increase for our troops in nearly a decade, to the historic passage and enactment of the historic Tax Cuts and Jobs Act - Scalise is focused on issues that affect Americans the most.

Critically wounded at a Congressional baseball practice on June 14, 2017, Scalise was saved by a heroic response from U.S. Capitol Police Special Agents and Alexandria Police Officers. Scalise fought for his life and returned to Congress, inspiring the nation with his resilience and optimism. Throughout his recovery, he was moved by the outpouring of prayers and support he and his family received from the American people.
---
| In a statement sent to Erik Aadland's campaign, Congressman Scalise said:
"Erik Aadland and I share many key values. We swore the same oath to support and defend our Constitution--Erik as a U.S. Army officer, and I as a Congressman. As citizens of energy-producing states, we both understand the economic and national security necessity to responsibly manage those resources for all Americans. Having navigated our current energy policy landscape, Erik is ready to work with me to resolve the issues we face in matching energy supply to demand. Furthermore, his career in the energy sector gives him experience with the kind of responsible financial management that is sorely needed in Washington. Erik's leadership experience prepares him to partner with his Congressional colleagues, building solutions to the challenges our country faces. I am proud to endorse Erik Aadland for Congress."
---
| |
---
---
|
# Erik's Remarks
---
| |
---
|
---
| "Congressman Scalise's endorsement means a great deal to me. I am inspired by his hard work to restore responsible stewardship of our energy resources, as well as his tireless advocacy for the best interests of all our citizens. He is a courageous man of principle, and I am grateful to have his support. I look forward to working with Congressman Scalise in Washington. "
---

| |
---
---

---
| |

|
## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being energy-independent and a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.
---
---
|
## About Aadland For Congress
---
| |
---
| Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign. There is no family fortune behind this drive; no generations of beer barons or Fat-Cat donors from California and New York backing our organization. Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in March of 2021. Staff personnel now cross the spectrum of political pundits, professional people, friends and neighbors.
You can stand with Erik by contributing to our cause. We can't do it alone, but together we can do anything.

Friends —
I have about 15 minutes to spare in my schedule today. I know that doesn’t sound like a lot of time, but with a schedule like mine, I can assure you it’s a gift.
And while I know our campaign sends a lot of emails your way, I want to take a few of those minutes to tell you about my decision to run for Senate in the first place — and why your support today is so important to our success.
The truth is: When Gabby and I first started talking about running, we weren’t sure what to expect. We knew that Arizona needed new leadership in the Senate — someone who would always put the people of our state first, who was willing to work across the aisle to deliver real results, and who would prioritize building bridges between the two parties — not burning them down.
We also knew we had some friends who would help us out. But when you’re talking about such a big campaign, we realized we’d need support from a lot of people we hadn’t met yet as well. Especially since I was making the decision to reject corporate PAC money.
You know the rest... we won in 2020 in large part because we ran the biggest grassroots campaign Arizona has ever seen.
But now we have a new mission: re-election.
And we’ve got our work cut out for us. The stakes were high before, but after last month it’s more critical than ever that we win this race. Because the Senate is now the final defense against a national abortion ban in the United States.
And in Arizona, the candidate that Trump just endorsed against me wants to go even further than the Supreme Court. He’s called for a national ban on abortion.
I know times are tough, but we can’t give in now. We need to make sure a ban like that never happens. Which is why I have to ask:

Sandra Dowling

body:
But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation. Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the
[View this message in your browser](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z7hujtv0avupvma1vmd3sd8s0j31jtpadrtoism8_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk1p7fcdkmcqjas3h6gonact66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2uop6acb6mpi6dd9gcaqmbc5nmlordcbjc8rj0opke4p76cjlmorbasbncorrfc77q9o74p1m62p6csjk65r61o5kckoe1d9hcjj6cphhmiqj4ptie1j72cljcdjr1db5e8gq48bi4bh28or5cjgm6o73cphm49fg)
[](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2ziab25d1lkj59lftngao0bsc9g1culuuqa8cjb50_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5hm1or6cdh2bs)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zp2vqkhd0k8efo89djodkaah5efquhltbem2kun0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5hm1or6cdh2bs)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Friend, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z3227m73s782td9p93tl1smjupglh4jl0sgmgok8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5hm1or6cdh2bs)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zvajif4b1cqpi1k1s0n3btqp55j8mg7m96ff91ng_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5hm1or6cdh2bs)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z178o0dpslhnij72copl8fq8pmd0ngbjq8klef4g_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5hm1or6cdh2bs)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zgav3efrsvdr3m2metqpfap8hl9pr0pldebofg2o_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5hm1or6cdh2bs)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zf131k7v7hr385koth0j08dijkiusilrbfao5r8o_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5hm1or6cdh2bs)

This is personal to me.

I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot.

Derek, It’s the beginning of August, and election season is in full swing. We’ve got a lot of crucial races in Virginia this year, and once again the eyes of the nation are on the Commonwealth. Control over the U.S. House hangs in the balance, and will come down to a few critical seats here at home. Reps. Elaine Luria, Abigail Spanberger, and Jennifer Wexton are in the middle of tough races, and the need for us to send them back to Washington for another term continues to grow with every passing day. **[Will you help me send our three outstanding congresswomen back to Washington this November?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48694560/359217219/308851134?refcode=dpva-em-220802-swecker&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NDIzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZWJhMDIzNC05YTEyLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7NUNQvB_C_KxtSi3j_b_mNKOZyOAOxgoVWMtjSARWKM=)** We’ve said it a lot over the past month, but it bears repeating: after the overturn of _Roe v. Wade_ , so many of our rights appear to be on the chopping block. It’s no longer just about abortion, but now the GOP has taken aim at access to contraception and the freedom for consenting adults to marry the ones they love. It feels like we learn something new from the January 6th Committee every day. If Trump’s lapdog Kevin McCarthy is in charge of the House, we know he’ll shut down their investigation into the insurrection before jetting off to Mar-A-Lago to tell his boss. We can’t let that happen. These rights that we hold sacred are the GOP’s target. We know this, because they tell us, time and time again. We need to listen. The staff and I at the Democratic Party of Virginia are working tirelessly to ensure that all Virginians’ personal freedoms are protected, but we can’t do it alone. The GOP is working overtime to continue turning back the clock on our progress. **[That’s why I’m asking you to join me in this fight, Derek. Can I count on you to help me save these three seats and preserve Virginia’s future?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48694561/359217220/308851134?refcode=dpva-em-220802-swecker&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NDIzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZWJhMDIzNC05YTEyLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7NUNQvB_C_KxtSi3j_b_mNKOZyOAOxgoVWMtjSARWKM=)** Thank you for your support. | Fellow activist,

Recently, we have seen more of what the modern enemies of democracy want to do with their power should they succeed in destroying it.

They want to destroy all equality before the law. They want to deny same-sex and interracial couples the right to marry. They want to strip us of our capability to make decisions for our own bodies, **to force people into pregnancy by denying us the use of contraception, and then force us into birth or death through the denial of reproductive health care.

We know that the majority of Pennsylvanians disagree with these positions and believe in protecting reproductive and LGBTQ+ rights.**

The connection between anti-democratic extremism and the war on our rights is easy to see here in Pennsylvania. Pennsylvania’s Republican Party nominated a candidate for Governor who was an enthusiastic participant in Donald Trump’s plot to overturn the 2020 general election. This candidate wants a no-exceptions ban on abortion and has demonstrated disgust for anyone who doesn’t agree with his belief that homosexuality is “aberrant sexual conduct.”

We even have a Congressman who voted against protecting same-sex and interracial marriages three days before going to his own son’s same-sex wedding.

NPP’s own Chief Executive Officer Kadida Kenner writes, “The horrors of the insurrection painted a picture of our new, grim reality. One in which a relentless and violent minority rides roughshod over our rights until they get what they want. We see that right here in Pennsylvania, where extremist politicians are attempting to force through constitutional amendments which would strip residents of a laundry list of essential rights and freedoms.”

Friends,

I want to thank you for your generous support of my congressional campaign over the last eight months.**With voting ending today, we 'll soon find out whether I'll take on Kim Schrier in the General Election.
**
It's been a tough primary battle. I am the only candidate in this race to face attacks from both the Democrat incumbent and, unfortunately, a fellow Republican candidate. While facing lies is always difficult, the intensity of the attacks proved that I am the candidate to bet on this Primary.

Democrats don't want me to face Kim Schrier in the General Election. **My track record of winning competitive elections makes me a threat.** And I'm the only Republican candidate in this race to ever lead her in an official poll.

I fought against the attacks and set the record straight on my proven conservative track record.**I believe in taking a stand and fighting for what 's right - that's what I've done for my constituents as a King County Councilmember.** And that's what I'll continue to do in Congress.

If I make it to the General Election, you can count on me to keep fighting. I'm not planning on taking any breaks because I know flipping the 8th from blue to red requires putting everything on the table. **With the continued support of voters like you, I know we can win.**

If you haven't already, there is still time to return your ballot. Find a drop box location [**here**](http://email.sermodigital.com/ct/60553050:WjWa-2hUN:m:1:2574580452:D61380FC5D635EB254716E2BB43B62E6:r) and ensure your ballot is submitted by 8PM.

You can also remind friends and family to vote by sharing my "I voted for Reagan" graphic on Facebook [**here**](http://email.sermodigital.com/ct/60553051:WjWa-2hUN:m:1:2574580452:D61380FC5D635EB254716E2BB43B62E6:r).

Whatever the outcome, I couldn't have made it this far without your support. Thank you.

With gratitude,

Reagan Dunn

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter — Justice Democrats Cori
Bush and Rashida Tlaib are the progressive leaders we need in Congress.
Their primaries are today — we need your help to fuel them to victory.
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/113159?refcode=em20220802-24544&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=24544%2E1203867%2E9LzxP1 ]Chip in $3 to help JD re-elect the Squad »

We need fighters for the people in Congress. When the Supreme Court
overturned Roe v. Wade, Cori and Rashida put their bodies on the line and
got arrested protesting for abortion rights.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/113159?refcode=em20220802-24544&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=24544%2E1203867%2E9LzxP1 ]Rashida Tlaib kneeling with a 'My Body My Choice' sign at the protest
outside the Supreme Court

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/113159?refcode=em20220802-24544&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&akid=24544%2E1203867%2E9LzxP1 ]Cori Bush surrounded by two police officers, getting arrested outside
the Supreme Court

When the Biden administration and Congress were going to allow the
eviction moratorium to expire, Cori camped out in front of the Capitol and
galvanized action to reinstate the moratorium last year.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/113159?refcode=em20220802-24544&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1005&akid=24544%2E1203867%2E9LzxP1 ]Cori Bush standing in front of a crowd of people at night on the
Capitol steps during the eviction moratorium expiration protest in August
2021

When Palestinian human rights are under attack, Rashida (the only
Palestinian-American in Congress) will always raise her voice.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/113159?refcode=em20220802-24544&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1006&akid=24544%2E1203867%2E9LzxP1 ]Rashida Tlaib speaking into a microphone with a shirt that reads
'Palestine is a feminist, queer, refugee, racial justice issue'

Peter, on
every issue, Cori and Rashida are fighting for the people. We need them in
Congress. We need your support to help them defeat corporate Democrats in
today’s primaries.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/113159?refcode=em20220802-24544&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1026&akid=24544%2E1203867%2E9LzxP1 ]Can you chip in $3 to help Justice Democrats re-elect
the Squad and keep our bloc of JDs in Congress strong? Give what you can
today »

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/113159?refcode=em20220802-24544&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1027&akid=24544%2E1203867%2E9LzxP1 ]Contribute

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1028&akid=24544%2E1203867%2E9LzxP1 ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=1029&akid=24544%2E1203867%2E9LzxP1 ]Centers for Disease Control and your state public health department.

I'm not a huge fan of broadcasting my birthday, but your notes were really kind. In this last trip around the sun, I became a dad to wonderful Lily, we did some crucial work fighting back against Republican extremism, and I have a lot of reflections I'd like to share with you. **But first, I need your help. My race is one of the most competitive in the country, and with our razor-thin House majority, we cannot afford to lose my seat to MAGA Republicans.[_If you could chip in today to help me win so we can keep the House blue, it would mean the world to me._](https://act.myngp.com/el/xRnd5MYcTR_ne3W5CJhBy6AhEReBMT7EuCp8Gf4IcOM=/la5GgxP80RJjRCm8zwudteBSZ6cBa2M4lASQrDOwt2k=?refcode=E17390-20220802-BdayThankYou-SL-Other-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=22)** Though I am a year older now, I am still one of the youngest members of Congress. I can speak from experience to say this: in order to actually make change, **we need to empower a new generation of leaders.** Costs of living are sky-high, climate change is ravaging communities like mine, and our fundamental civil rights are under attack left and right. Business as usual in Congress won't cut it anymore. I am doing everything I can to put you first and tackle our biggest challenges head-on. While Republicans are busy spreading conspiracy theories and attacking our freedom and our democracy, I am laser-focused on proving to the American people that Democrats can actually help: lowering costs, delivering affordable health care, addressing homelessness and keeping our neighborhoods safe. **Protecting our Democratic majority in the House is absolutely crucial if we want to address any of these issues, and the race for control is neck-and-neck.[_Anything you can donate to help me win re-election and keep Congress out of the hands of MAGA Republicans like Tom Patti and Marjorie Taylor Greene would be greatly appreciated._](https://act.myngp.com/el/xRnd5MYcTR_ne3W5CJhBy6AhEReBMT7EuCp8Gf4IcOM=/la5GgxP80RJjRCm8zwudteBSZ6cBa2M4lASQrDOwt2k=?refcode=E17390-20220802-BdayThankYou-SL-Other-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=22)** _If you 've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | **[$9](https://act.myngp.com/el/xRnd5MYcTR_ne3W5CJhBy6AhEReBMT7EuCp8Gf4IcOM=/la5GgxP80RJjRCm8zwudteBSZ6cBa2M4lASQrDOwt2k=?express_lane=true&refcode=E17390-20220802-BdayThankYou-EG-Other-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=9)**

clean_body: | | Hi Peter, I wanted to personally thank you all for the birthday wishes yesterday. I'm not a huge fan of broadcasting my birthday, but your notes were really kind. In this last trip around the sun, I became a dad to wonderful Lily, we did some crucial work fighting back against Republican extremism, and I have a lot of reflections I'd like to share with you. But first, I need your help. My race is one of the most competitive in the country, and with our razor-thin House majority, we cannot afford to lose my seat to MAGA Republicans. Though I am a year older now, I am still one of the youngest members of Congress. I can speak from experience to say this: in order to actually make change, we need to empower a new generation of leaders. Costs of living are sky-high, climate change is ravaging communities like mine, and our fundamental civil rights are under attack left and right. Business as usual in Congress won't cut it anymore. I am doing everything I can to put you first and tackle our biggest challenges head-on. While Republicans are busy spreading conspiracy theories and attacking our freedom and our democracy, I am laser-focused on proving to the American people that Democrats can actually help: lowering costs, delivering affordable health care, addressing homelessness and keeping our neighborhoods safe. Protecting our Democratic majority in the House is absolutely crucial if we want to address any of these issues, and the race for control is neck-and-neck. If you 've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | Thanks again for the birthday card, Peter. Friend,
I’m truly grateful for staunch allies like you.
_**It wouldn’t be right to go another day without expressing my gratitude for your unwavering support of my re-election campaign.**_
As Election Day nears, I’m taking some time to think back over the events that unfolded during my first term as Governor.
Do you remember Biden’s Democrat allies in the legacy media running to cover for Dr. Fauci by supporting unscientific lockdowns and the harmful masking of our children?
Or the Biden administration blatantly and disgracefully colluding with Big Tech to silence free speech and cancel all dissent during the pandemic?
_Fortunately, they were not the only ones with access to COVID data..._
As Governor of Florida, I reached out to and spoke with some of the best scientists and doctors in the world at Harvard, Stanford, and Oxford to assess the necessity of the Left’s destructive lockdown policies.
**The data showed the Left’s draconian policies were failures, and I kept Florida open. And I’m glad I did.**
**Every American has a right to work.**
**Every business has a right to operate.**
That’s why I stepped in and stopped local governments from restricting people from working or operating a business. [_**Do you support my decision to keep Florida open? Stand with me now. >>>**_](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=41d2cd9b0a8e4584bfdd27b4495a2402&_e=AKoQV021crmo-J6v71ywpWR_D75Y7q4oQDaO3eay4yEsWWbER3QA6BhvvXycAoO6LDDFpbl9k2N219-xBoxrb72MxsMutocIewShf8wF5yF0pJZAnPnKmSPlWYWcn09GzeV0WEavmS84WtPet2jDRFo7gozT92QkP1t-74mTgobkL7X5-s-S8ijW-byyKEm9v1LjXS6T06KiC-Aq0yseTD6TlgX5QSAaiGSQH3W7cmNOuRq-oUg50TNR-zCHbZdNRHUyCkUscfS_ApVBlKR0gY0lWq4bLMl0ZD6_M1TzQyicMAN87DgCljfoAXjyU72xIyWU9MolNl0fwzGRvLOggA%3D%3D)
I even issued pardons for those who were threatened by local governments with jail and ridiculous fines for operating during the pandemic.
I put my entire political career on the line to Keep Florida Free. _**I fought back.**_
It showed you exactly the kind of leader I am. I don’t cower with fear about what the media may say — _I just lead_.
In 2019, when I was inaugurated as Florida’s 46th Governor, I didn’t let the grass grow under my feet before turning the Tallahassee establishment upside down.
I immediately fulfilled several of my key campaign promises to Floridians, including:
✅ Changing the Florida Supreme Court for a generation by appointing three rock-solid conservative justices.
✅ Signing the largest expansion of school choice in the nation, giving parents greater freedom to choose the education that best meets their child’s needs.
✅ Restoring election integrity by holding election officials accountable by accepting the resignation of Broward County Supervisor of Elections Brenda Snipes from public office, as well as suspending Palm Beach County Election Supervisor Susan Bucher.
✅ Suspending Broward County Sheriff Scott Israel for his failure to protect the students at Marjorie Stoneman Douglas High School during the massacre at Parkland in 2018.
Of course, making these moves during my first few days in office was just a preview of what I set out to accomplish.
**Over my first three years, I’ve continued to steer Florida to a strong, safe, prosperous future with liberty as my guide and the Constitutions as my north star.**
[_**Do you think Florida is headed in the right direction? Rush in any amount now to keep our accomplishments going for another four years!**_](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=41d2cd9b0a8e4584bfdd27b4495a2402&_e=AKoQV021crmo-J6v71ywpWR_D75Y7q4oQDaO3eay4yEsWWbER3QA6BhvvXycAoO6LDDFpbl9k2N219-xBoxrb72MxsMutocIewShf8wF5yGTKYlmFWMbTDpKwq8-weq5UImzkRXg1mTZ-FG9XinDlE4EElv_ZM3YGBngFGGpB9bKN6YMYD9J06aeWPIsQ1b6t4Ux3PVkcmNvPw3XJEcBxv_o6XvNgr2Ebw8AN_pUJOEfbkCEjsUYBw7Pc6s6SVBSfbzSUfx_F51LA4NrCcgfzgb0ML6X8gAsorQuKE6ViEGzU60l4J9Wjy_8wowL9r9Py036O9Ic2XIxC-G1EsZKBQ%3D%3D)
I refuse to simply kick the can down the road or seek out the path of least resistance when it comes to doing the right thing.
I certainly don’t set my priorities according to what is preferred by Silicon Valley’s CEOs, Big Tech’s shady algorithms, or the corrupt media’s agenda!
I refuse to bow to pressure from the Biden administration, kiss the ring of power-hungry government bureaucrats like Fauci, or follow orders from woke corporations who want to dictate to us how to live and what to think.
**I was elected to lead, not to follow.**
As was the case when I was in the U.S. Navy, my mission has always been to advocate for the people I serve.
I’m proud that because of my work these last few years, Florida is known as _the freest state in the country._
Yet rather than celebrate our economy, our school children being freed of compulsory masking, and the influx of overtaxed Americans who are voting with their feet to move to Florida, I am being attacked by my Democrat opponents.
I know you understand that coordinated attacks and vitriol against a successful conservative Republican like me is business as usual from the lockdown Democrats. It’s pathetic to see my political opponents and detractors whine about my record of accomplishments.

With the Biden regime publicly cozying up to communist dictators in Cuba and Venezuela, you can be sure every victim of communism across the state is more willing than ever to reject the Democrat Party's choice for Governor this November.
**I’m going to battle for every vote.**
As you may remember, I narrowly won by a margin of just 0.4% four years ago during my first race for Governor!
We truly must be prepared for another knock-down, drag-out fight.

August 2, 2022
Dear friend,
I have been so proud to serve as mayor of Shelby County, Tennessee, the home of Memphis and several other great cities. With nearly one million residents, our county is one of the largest, most diverse, and greatest counties in the South.
My folks are regular working folks. My mom retired as the high school guidance counselor at Mitchell High School. My dad is an air-conditioner repairman. I grew up in a little church called Mt. Joyner on Hilbrook Road in Memphis. The church where everybody is somebody. I was blessed and lucky.
I’m a proud product of Memphis City Schools. I won scholarships to go to Morehouse, worked through law school at Yale. I taught at the University of Memphis, becoming the first black tenured full professor of law in the school’s history. I got into politics, and won my first race to City Council by 4 votes in 2011.
I believe this community is the one of the greatest in the country. This is a place, where a kid like me, no connections to anyone in particular, no wealth of any note, no last name of any consequence can work his way up to one of the top jobs in Memphis and Shelby County.

subject: Get Us To The Finish Line
body:
The race for Congress is Tightening

Dear friend,

With inflation on everyone's mind, the cost of food and gas affecting
everyone's pockets, and women's rights under attack, *we need effective
leadership* in Washington, D.C. to fight for these issues.

I want to report back to you that our campaign has covered a lot of ground,
building up tremendous momentum, and has become a grassroots campaign. We
are approaching our filing deadline on August 3rd and have *$12,500 left to
reach our goal <https://secure.actblue.com/donate/solages-for-congress-1>.* Can
I please count on you to get us across the finish line?

With less than three weeks left until the August 23rd primary, we see a
real opportunity to have your voices represented in Congress. We need
effective leadership with a proven track record of advocating and
delivering for our communities.

Sincerely,

Carrié Solages

Candidate for Congress, District 4

Solages for Congress

name: Harriet Hageman
subject: Pelosi’s favorite republican: Liz Cheney
body:
Liz Cheney signed a multi-year deal with Team Pelosi
[View this message in your browser](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zmcbl9hugmg9hgtr1p3ujitultnq4tmp4ronic20_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t56egn4tblm1on4t1kmepradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hfaclkm6qj2tj7mprb8objm6q6cdjlemrjbdpmmdhmasjmeoq32opkm8pmeo33e1jt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6coor9d9ic1p74phks2pm1ptgmlin48d245p25oh4cdim9ob7c9h64p324no)
Liz Cheney signed a multi-year deal with Team Pelosi |
Fellow Patriot,

In my home state of Wyoming, loyalty and freedom still mean something.

So why is _Republican_ Liz Cheney playing on Nancy Pelosi's team?

Not only did she vote to impeach President Trump, praise Dr. Fauci, and slander Americans like you as a "danger" to our Democracy . . .

She's taken a leading role on Pelosi's Soviet-Style January 6th Commission!

[**This kind of betrayal cannot continue, which is why I hope you'll support my America First Primary Challenge against Liz Cheney with a $35 or more campaign contribution?**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2za5su3qgr1uu2j484ahtr0ia3d6nc0lml0dsbm48_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5jm4oj2chh2bs)

My name is Harriet Hageman and, unlike Liz Cheney – who lives in Northern Virginia – Wyoming is my home.

Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age.

They're not just values Joe Biden and his radical Democrats hate – they run absolutely counter to the elitist values of Cheney and her establishment backers.

Unfortunately, it's those establishment backers – including Never-Trumpers at the Lincoln Project and NeoCons like John Bolton and John Boehner – who are now going all-in to keep Cheney in power.

Case in point, just a few weeks ago, Cheney held a ritzy fundraiser with Mitt Romney where she charged $10,000 a head for VIPs . . .

_On top of the nearly $5 million in campaign cash she's amassed from a steady stream of Never-Trumpers and Democrats!_

That's right – even the billionaire cousin of Far-Left Illinois Governor JB Pritzker shelled out $20,000 for Cheney!

**My friend, with the Never-Trump arm of the establishment working night and day to keep Cheney in power, I'm going to need patriots like you to keep my campaign to defeat her going.**

[**So please, won't you give an emergency $35, $50, $75, or $100 donation to my campaign so I can go dollar for dollar with her elitist backers?**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zgn1543sr20e1nluc3roo66mq44r5781s68idju0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5jm4oj2chh2bs)

It's unfortunately not hard to see why Democrats are teaming up with the establishment in taking Cheney's side.

Even before she voted to impeach President Trump on bogus charges in a sham hearing, she'd made it clear she sided with Big Government over _you_ .

Sure, she loves to go around appearing on CNN and _60 Minutes_ lecturing us about how "principled" she is, but there's nothing principled about betraying the 70% of Wyoming voters who voted for President Trump.

Nor is it "principled" to sit side-by-side with Nancy Pelosi in a Soviet-Style hearing that uses Big Government to punish conservatives as political prisoners!

My friend, there are dozens of issues Liz Cheney could be tackling instead of this sham January 6th commission.

She could be investigating Afghanistan and Joe Biden's incompetence.

She could be looking into Nancy Pelosi's spying on conservative representatives.

She could be questioning Dr. Fauci's dangerous Gain-of-Function research.

**But instead, she's scoring compliments from far-left anchors at CNN in her never-ending vendetta against President Trump and his supporters!**

[**There's no room in Wyoming, or the republican party for rabid anti-Trumpers who will sell out the constituents they represent for some positive press time from fake news stations like CNN, and I hope you'll help me.**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zd68u7p82k6nru1uhv1v5qps1pgjthsa48ea7s28_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5jm4oj2chh2bs)

As I said, loyalty and freedom still mean something here in Wyoming. While DC might be full of back-door deals and shifting political winds, the men and women of my state value the Cowboy ethos and ethic of riding for the brand.

You see, back in the old West, Cowboys gave their promise to stay loyal to the people who hired them. To the people who paid them.

They made a choice to fight for the brand as it was one of their own, to keep their word to the brand, and to never betray it.

As a DC insider, Liz Cheney knows nothing about that, but I do.

My family put down roots on a ranch outside of Laramie 1879, where we've raised cattle ever since.

Out here, we have a strong work ethic and fierce independence, and we don't take kindly to Big Government Socialists like Nancy Pelosi trying to control us.

It's why I've spent my professional life as a lawyer battling Big Government and federal agencies trying to usurp our rights, and why I'll do it in Washington, too.

I'm also:
* 100% Pro-Life
* A strong supporter of our Second Amendment
* Totally and Completely Against Vaccine Mandates
* Believe in the need to fight for our Election Integrity
* A believer in our fight for election integrity
* Committed to government transparency and ending wasteful spending!

My friend, these are the issues conservatives need to put front and center: _Not_ joining Nancy Pelosi in some anti-American tribunal designed to persecute fellow Americans!

[**So please, would you consider giving a $35, $50, $75, $100, $250, $500, $1,000, or $2,900 donation to my campaign to defeat Liz Cheney in the next 3 days?**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z1agmr2ro262ho2jgr5n5g5fuqin4sjigvdnmf0o_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5jm4oj2chh2bs)

As I told you earlier in this letter, Cheney has $5 million in campaign cash ready to bail her out in this race.

With each passing day more and more Democrats flock to her side, desperate to keep their war on President Trump and you going.

Because of that, I need your urgent financial support in the next 3 days.

Of course, if you can't quite afford to give $35 at this time, I understand

[**But know a gift of any amount lets me know you support my Trump-endorsed campaign against Cheney**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z6fia8rcuo4ademiljitichnj9n3qcl9bg41p66o_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5jm4oj2chh2bs) **\--- and helps me crisscross the 97,914 square miles of Wyoming to talk to each and every voter in this state.**

My friend, I started by telling you how, out here in my home state of Wyoming, loyalty and freedom still mean something.

And even though you may not live here, I hope these values mean something to you, too. I look forward you your response. And I want to thank you for your support.

Respectfully,
[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zabnp1c1lga5mfb7k2pgp2vpjohjlm6ve9gcmp3o_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5jm4oj2chh2bs)
Harriet Hageman
America First Conservative for Congress (WY)

PS: Remember – Democrat megadonors are shelling out tens of thousands for Liz Cheney. But while she has the support of Democrats and establishment career politicians like Mitt Romney, she doesn't speak for you and me.

[**Will you help me prove that by sending her packing with a $35 or more campaign donation to my primary challenge?**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zqqf3du4k1gb7jb52a4o1ccsmhbdtne0b871flh0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5jm4oj2chh2bs)

[DONATE](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zb1ip69gtfuql5cg3ii3q0ftuebqb7r32836kf6g_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5jm4oj2chh2bs)

body:
Can you make a donation before ballots are due?
#
Peter, we’re making a final push before ballots are due at 8 PM Pacific in Pramila’s WA-7 primary.
77 donations from this email before then will help us contact as many voters as possible and keep our campaign strong. [**Can you chip in a grassroots donation now? Pramila’s average online donation this year is just $28.79.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/14643?refcode=em20220802-1477&t=1&akid=1477%2E420207%2E4FtIwk)
-Team Jayapal
\-----Forwarded Message-----
Sent: August 1, 2022
From: Jayapal HQ
Subject: Tomorrow and November
Pramila’s primary is tomorrow and we’re working hard to contact voters who haven’t yet returned their ballots. But it’s not _only_ about tomorrow, Peter.
**We must win tomorrow, and we also must continue our work to protect the Democratic majority in November.** We must elect more people-first progressives to build support for Medicare for All and other transformative policies. And we must continue our advocacy work right now to invest in clean energy, health care, and taxing corporations.
[**Peter, can you chip in today to fuel Pramila’s re-election campaign and all of her work for the people? Our campaign is funded by grassroots donations, not corporate PACs.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/14643?refcode=em20220802-1477&t=2&akid=1477%2E420207%2E4FtIwk)
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/14643?refcode=em20220802-1477&t=21&akid=1477%2E420207%2E4FtIwk)**
Your contribution to Pramila’s campaign supports keeping a progressive fighter in Congress working towards transformative change for the people. In a time when nothing is certain, we must make sure we re-elect Pramila.
And in a tough midterm election year, we must ensure right-wing extremism doesn’t take the majority in the U.S. House. That’s why Pramila is working on her re-election campaign AND supporting Democrats in tough swing district races. Not only that, she’s out there trying to get people-first progressives elected in open seats so our movement for M4A, climate action, and a stronger social safety net can grow.
Pramila is relying on your support so she can win her primary tomorrow, protect the Democratic majority in the House, and continue her advocacy in Congress for social, economic, racial, and environmental justice.
[**Please, chip in today to help us reach those final voters and fuel our work through November. Pramila is counting on you.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/14643?refcode=em20220802-1477&t=22&akid=1477%2E420207%2E4FtIwk)
Thanks for being on this team, and for your continued support.
In solidarity,
Team Jayapal

body:

---
Friend -- **We’re less than 100 days out from Election Day. That means it’s all hands on deck to make sure we re-elect Senator Ron Johnson, defeat Governor Tony Evers, send a Republican to Congress from the third district, and win at all levels of the ballot in November.** The past year and a half has been about laying the groundwork for success – and thanks to the help of supporters like you, we’ve done just that. Alongside county party leaders, we prioritized election integrity and submitted the highest number of poll workers in state history at 5,000. We worked with our grassroots activists to deliver conservative victories in every corner of Wisconsin during our spring elections – helping us fight back against liberal overreach at the local level. Our field teams have already made over 1 million voter contacts to bring our message directly to the people. _And we’re just getting started._ **Friend, it’s thanks to you that we are in a strong position heading into the fall, and we’re counting on you to help us get over the finish line.** **If you haven’t already, sign up to volunteer**[**here**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=VsLgeNFrtuHusRivV19v3aCXxtdEYxug7BpyM8N6AZw&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=100_days_e_solicit&n=2)**to help us bring the message directly to voters ahead of Election Day. If you can’t volunteer, but would like to support our efforts financially, click**[**here**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDVhotX5bAWdGtS0bZ-ZSpL4PtfrhmtpGVKWPhlqnhzYlE&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=100_days_e_solicit&n=3)**.** We can’t do this without you, Friend. name: Team AOC
subject: It’s time to ban this practice
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
We’re drawing the line on insider trading in Congress.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220802-3268-header&t=1&akid=3268%2E2526796%2EvXts4i)
Members of Congress have access to sensitive and privileged information as part of their jobs to be able to anticipate and legislate for what’s to come.
**And right now, Members of Congress are able to use this sensitive information to make huge profits from buying and trading individual stocks that they know will perform well.**
Earlier this year, we emailed asking folks to sign our ‘Ban Members of Congress from Trading Stocks’ petition to help Alexandria and our movement keep up the pressure to end this practice. 5,295 folks signed the petition!
**And our mounting pressure is working:**
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/sign/ban-stock-trading-802/?source=em20220802-3268-P_ENG_ANO_HDL&t=2&akid=3268%2E2526796%2EvXts4i)
[Will you join Alexandria and our movement by adding your name to our petition demanding a ban on members of Congress trading individual stocks? Your signature will help us keep up the pressure to pass this ban now.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/sign/ban-stock-trading-802/?source=em20220802-3268-P_ENG_ANO_HDL&t=4&akid=3268%2E2526796%2EvXts4i)
**[Add your name](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/sign/ban-stock-trading-802/?source=em20220802-3268-P_ENG_ANO_HDL&t=5&akid=3268%2E2526796%2EvXts4i)**
Alexandria has worked with her colleagues to ban members of Congress from trading individual stock for YEARS. She’s repeatedly said that Congress members should not have the ability to access privileged information and be able to hold and trade individual stock.
To be clear, it’s one thing to have a blind trust or invest in a mutual fund or index fund. These are vehicles of investment that are broad and that individuals in Congress don’t have control over.
But the fact is that a majority of Congress members hold and trade individual stocks. Last year, there were at least 75 members of Congress who held individual stock in Johnson & Johnson, Moderna, and Pfizer.1 **That’s where we should be drawing the line.**
There have been lots of stories and scandals about stock trading, but now – thanks to increased public pressure and attention – we may have a shot to pass this ban once and for all.
[If you agree that Members of Congress should not be profiting off of sensitive and privileged information, add your name to our petition now.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/sign/ban-stock-trading-802/?source=em20220802-3268-P_ENG_ANO_HDL&t=6&akid=3268%2E2526796%2EvXts4i)
In solidarity,
Team AOC

body:
Democracy is on the line
|
---

Friend,
By now, we know you’ve seen what the United States Supreme Court has done this year. They’ve slashed fundamental reproductive rights, destroyed efforts to combat climate change, allowed gerrymandered maps to remain in place, and attacked the rights of Native Americans. So, surely, that must be the worst of it?
Not exactly. Let's talk about _Moore v. Harper_.
Please join All On The Line as we discuss the Supreme Court’s decision to hear _Moore_ , an appeal filed by North Carolina Republicans that could give state legislatures unchecked power to control congressional redistricting. clean_body: Democracy is on the line | Friend, By now, we know you’ve seen what the United States Supreme Court has done this year. They’ve slashed fundamental reproductive rights, destroyed efforts to combat climate change, allowed gerrymandered maps to remain in place, and attacked the rights of Native Americans. So, surely, that must be the worst of it? Not exactly. Let's talk about Moore v. Harper. Please join All On The Line as we discuss the Supreme Court’s decision to hear Moore , an appeal filed by North Carolina Republicans that could give state legislatures unchecked power to control congressional redistricting. The case is based on the extreme right-wing “independent state legislature” (ISL) theory, which argues that state courts cannot invalidate laws enacted by state legislatures that pertain to federal elections. We can’t emphasize enough how radical this theory is. If far-right politicians succeed in this effort to diminish checks and balances in the states, it will undermine more than a century of precedent and wreak havoc on the American federalist system (and American democracy) as we know it. name: Harriet Hageman
subject: I’m tired of republicans who bow to Pelosi
body:
Liz Cheney signed a multi-year deal with Team Pelosi [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c0577%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=JESGlE4Wrbt%2b3b8wenokRg&sysid=1)
Liz Cheney signed a multi-year deal with Team Pelosi |
Fellow Patriot,

In my home state of Wyoming, loyalty and freedom still mean something.

So why is _Republican_ Liz Cheney playing on Nancy Pelosi's team?

Not only did she vote to impeach President Trump, praise Dr. Fauci, and slander Americans like you as a "danger" to our Democracy . . .

She's taken a leading role on Pelosi's Soviet-Style January 6th Commission!

[**This kind of betrayal cannot continue, which is why I hope you'll support my America First Primary Challenge against Liz Cheney with a $35 or more campaign contribution?**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c39360%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=dEkUezb2bv%2b9lhRxUcac7A&sysid=1)

My name is Harriet Hageman and, unlike Liz Cheney - who lives in Northern Virginia - Wyoming is my home.

Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age.

They're not just values Joe Biden and his radical Democrats hate - they run absolutely counter to the elitist values of Cheney and her establishment backers.

Unfortunately, it's those establishment backers - including Never-Trumpers at the Lincoln Project and NeoCons like John Bolton and John Boehner - who are now going all-in to keep Cheney in power.

Case in point, just a few weeks ago, Cheney held a ritzy fundraiser with Mitt Romney where she charged $10,000 a head for VIPs . . .

_On top of the nearly $5 million in campaign cash she's amassed from a steady stream of Never-Trumpers and Democrats!_

That's right - even the billionaire cousin of Far-Left Illinois Governor JB Pritzker shelled out $20,000 for Cheney!

**My friend, with the Never-Trump arm of the establishment working night and day to keep Cheney in power, I'm going to need patriots like you to keep my campaign to defeat her going.**

[**So please, won't you give an emergency $35, $50, $75, or $100 donation to my campaign so I can go dollar for dollar with her elitist backers?**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c39361%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=L5BsKuhPgYPmFRCQIK29Ag&sysid=1)

It's unfortunately not hard to see why Democrats are teaming up with the establishment in taking Cheney's side.

Even before she voted to impeach President Trump on bogus charges in a sham hearing, she'd made it clear she sided with Big Government over _you_.

Sure, she loves to go around appearing on CNN and _60 Minutes_ lecturing us about how "principled" she is, but there's nothing principled about betraying the 70% of Wyoming voters who voted for President Trump.

Nor is it "principled" to sit side-by-side with Nancy Pelosi in a Soviet-Style hearing that uses Big Government to punish conservatives as political prisoners!

My friend, there are dozens of issues Liz Cheney could be tackling instead of this sham January 6th commission.

She could be investigating Afghanistan and Joe Biden's incompetence.

She could be looking into Nancy Pelosi's spying on conservative representatives.

She could be questioning Dr. Fauci's dangerous Gain-of-Function research.

**But instead, she's scoring compliments from far-left anchors at CNN in her never-ending vendetta against President Trump and his supporters!**

[**There's no room in Wyoming, or the republican party for rabid anti-Trumpers who will sell out the constituents they represent for some positive press time from fake news stations like CNN, and I hope you'll help me.**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c39362%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ApjI2bRRzl8FWnirsyc4ug&sysid=1)

As I said, loyalty and freedom still mean something here in Wyoming. While DC might be full of back-door deals and shifting political winds, the men and women of my state value the Cowboy ethos and ethic of riding for the brand.

You see, back in the old West, Cowboys gave their promise to stay loyal to the people who hired them. To the people who paid them.

They made a choice to fight for the brand as it was one of their own, to keep their word to the brand, and to never betray it.

As a DC insider, Liz Cheney knows nothing about that, but I do.

My family put down roots on a ranch outside of Laramie 1879, where we've raised cattle ever since.

Out here, we have a strong work ethic and fierce independence, and we don't take kindly to Big Government Socialists like Nancy Pelosi trying to control us.

It's why I've spent my professional life as a lawyer battling Big Government and federal agencies trying to usurp our rights, and why I'll do it in Washington, too.

I'm also:
* 100% Pro-Life
* A strong supporter of our Second Amendment
* Totally and Completely Against Vaccine Mandates
* Believe in the need to fight for our Election Integrity
* A believer in our fight for election integrity
* Committed to government transparency and ending wasteful spending!

My friend, these are the issues conservatives need to put front and center: _Not_ joining Nancy Pelosi in some anti-American tribunal designed to persecute fellow Americans!

[**So please, would you consider giving a $35, $50, $75, $100, $250, $500, $1,000, or $2,900 donation to my campaign to defeat Liz Cheney in the next 3 days?**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c39363%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=i%2fZ8q%2bT4IMogaql%2fTwmljA&sysid=1)

As I told you earlier in this letter, Cheney has $5 million in campaign cash ready to bail her out in this race.

With each passing day more and more Democrats flock to her side, desperate to keep their war on President Trump and you going.

Because of that, I need your urgent financial support in the next 3 days.

Of course, if you can't quite afford to give $35 at this time, I understand

[**But know a gift of any amount lets me know you support my Trump-endorsed campaign against Cheney**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c39364%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=aQcoTDE1abrU2h5EN3%2b44g&sysid=1) **\--- and helps me crisscross the 97,914 square miles of Wyoming to talk to each and every voter in this state.**

My friend, I started by telling you how, out here in my home state of Wyoming, loyalty and freedom still mean something.

And even though you may not live here, I hope these values mean something to you, too. I look forward you your response. And I want to thank you for your support.

Respectfully,
[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c39375%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Za79a1vghekXSIHiH5dUdw&sysid=1)
Harriet Hageman
America First Conservative for Congress (WY)

PS: Remember - Democrat megadonors are shelling out tens of thousands for Liz Cheney. But while she has the support of Democrats and establishment career politicians like Mitt Romney, she doesn't speak for you and me.

[**Will you help me prove that by sending her packing with a $35 or more campaign donation to my primary challenge?**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c39376%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=kAZTWvore23jpV2TSn9iFg&sysid=1) [DONATE](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c39377%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=SvHPhVMOwN1JS71LcC4CuQ&sysid=1)

name: Candace Owens, Co-founder of BLEXIT
subject: The most personal email I’ve ever sent you
body:
This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zdmbe5bkqe64ap7khi2m3t2bdih2b5gt4g7msp7o_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5jmao72c5h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jmgr32t5nmepradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf4o9le9q61dpnm4pn8thjmdie8odmc8pn9ctjcoon2cdkssrrct336mob6tbnc3jt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6coor9d9ic1p7aphmc2pm4ptgmlin49fg)
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z6bjm3q49iic4j8bcijcqiprsieg266dc678nlso_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5jmao72c5h2bs)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2iur0ekevpatt5rm6k3nsno2jtjq8rrdin9r2lo_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5jmao72c5h2bs)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Friend, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z5itf38ah0pt48g5k01ffsns0a586qfr0tlrkg60_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5jmao72c5h2bs)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zg6djtk4u0qfl70pbavqot325pe7c6dlti4a5cmo_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5jmao72c5h2bs)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zi470115dkuks21sc9bmais28n0oeh3mia44vfho_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5jmao72c5h2bs)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z37tlnrjr3v15s4bheeoh3massgie6hoik7i1pko_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5jmao72c5h2bs)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zrcsk20d8v9rpj7r7l0rs9h2qddkppfsss7fqndg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5jmao72c5h2bs)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2znt9rhjv48d5mlhtinls0lvt97341skjqqac4v88_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5jmao72c5h2bs)

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

This is personal to me.

I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z5t8h869j59en6gfu03f5ed6mha1ohfk4i0iaga0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5jmao72c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zsqu5hijo0330b5879r55sppbpd6bsambslkbhho_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5jmao72c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ze0lugvrnp88jesjsq3sob8fb1eo7um261lf5278_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5jmao72c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zgtp1692l9if00jjgpjeglq99fohhbsposhn65c8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5jmao72c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4lhuqvp45o4ese8njh9v1ekrmsa7vk9k2nla0oo_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5jmao72c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ztlopm4pqsvrkb15s2m778vg9ds0tpek16f95ggo_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5jmao72c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zibjmi6tieianrspp1hodetol83k11pelqs3if20_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5jmao72c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zmnq1f7sks0r5lvr7o3o0qo4f790lqkdish004cg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5jmao72c5h2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z0nbaphpf8v4u3s5iolpr3f1u7ubmac24abd5p28_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5jmao72c5h2bs)

This is my last message to you before you close this email.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment.

My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause.

[_**Please consider making the most generous donation you can today by clicking here.**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zun2gf9qor7vq3bp4lh6dgr8uoe3f268tn212pm0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s5jmao72c5h2bs)

But I must share my story and tell you why I created the Friend, This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation. Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation. For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop. In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities. Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture. Now I 'll share my story... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities. Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking. We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals. This is WRONG. I've dealt with racism... I 've even received death threats. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable. But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up. I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters. I am breaking the rules. It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... I 'm not doing that. You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country. So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss). When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing. Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for: School Choice: Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools. The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. Criminal Justice Reform: The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities. Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message. Entrepreneurship: I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire. BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore. The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor. This is personal to me. I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot. Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today: This is my last message to you before you close this email. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment. My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause. Thank you, Friend. subject: I'm ready to defeat Ron Johnson. Are you with me?
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Cheri Beasley for North Carolina
body:
Together we must build the largest grassroots coalitions that Wisconsin and North Carolina have ever seen.
#

When I decided to run for U.S. Senate, I knew that my path here would be different than most.
Just like Cheri Beasley, I don't come from a wealthy family. I didn't enter this race with a bunch of wealthy donors lining up to write big checks to this campaign.
My mom was a public school teacher and my dad built catalytic converters at the General Motors plant. Those jobs were our family's ticket to the middle class.
Ever since I was a little kid, my parents taught me never to settle for what is, but to reach for what can be. It was how I graduated high school at the age of 16 and went on to be elected to the Wisconsin State Assembly when I was 25.
Then, after careful thought and consideration, I decided to get in this race to defeat Ron Johnson.
It was a big decision. I knew that, just like North Carolina’s Senate race, this was going to be one of the most competitive U.S. Senate races in the entire country. And these are races that we must win if we're going to defend the Democratic Senate majority.
But I was willing to bet that if I decided to run, people would come together in large numbers to be a part of this campaign. Because the truth is that no single person can flip a Senate seat alone. It will only happen if we're in this together.
So today, I need your help to reach the goals we've set for our campaign.
These goals are not arbitrary. They're what we need to raise to flip Wisconsin and North Carolina for Democrats.
So I am asking:
