hint: it's because he's not in Pennsylvania | | | Hi Peter, it’s John Fetterman. I hope you’ve been having a safe + fun summer with your friends + loved ones. Though our summer is costing a *lot* more than it did last year and is much hotter than last year, the Fetterman Fam is having a great summer right here in Braddock, PA. 😎 Dr. Oz, on the other hand, can’t say the same. I mean, he spent the 4th of July partying it up at a gala in New York, surrounded by celebrities like Ryan Seacrest and Kendall Jenner. **He's able to beat the Pennsylvania heat, and heat all across rural America, by not living in rural America.** I dare this dude to stay in Pennsylvania for like, one day. 🙄 It’s an icky reminder that ultra-rich GOP Dr. Oz doesn't even have to worry about raising money for his campaign. He’s already self-funding his campaign, plus he has essentially unlimited access to other celebrities + millionaires. **Meanwhile, all summer long, with this heatwave, we've seen a massive slowdown in online fundraising, since our donors (aka real people like you, Peter) are rightfully spending time outside in the sun with loved ones.** Don’t get me wrong. Our campaign is PROUDLY bought + paid for by the people, and we’d never have it any other way. But with the stakes this high, I can’t afford to fall behind Dr. Oz in PA. And United Rural Democrats can’t afford to fall behind their fundraising goals to elect Democrats across the Midwest, either. **[Can you please make an $25 donation between my campaign + United Rural Democrats’s campaign to help make up for the summer fundraising slow down? clean_body: hint: it's because he's not in Pennsylvania | | | Hi Peter, it’s John Fetterman. I hope you’ve been having a safe + fun summer with your friends + loved ones. Though our summer is costing a lot more than it did last year and is much hotter than last year, the Fetterman Fam is having a great summer right here in Braddock, PA. 😎 Dr. Oz, on the other hand, can’t say the same. I mean, he spent the 4th of July partying it up at a gala in New York, surrounded by celebrities like Ryan Seacrest and Kendall Jenner. He's able to beat the Pennsylvania heat, and heat all across rural America, by not living in rural America. I dare this dude to stay in Pennsylvania for like, one day. 🙄 It’s an icky reminder that ultra-rich GOP Dr. Oz doesn't even have to worry about raising money for his campaign. He’s already self-funding his campaign, plus he has essentially unlimited access to other celebrities + millionaires. Meanwhile, all summer long, with this heatwave, we've seen a massive slowdown in online fundraising, since our donors (aka real people like you, Peter) are rightfully spending time outside in the sun with loved ones. Don’t get me wrong. Our campaign is PROUDLY bought + paid for by the people, and we’d never have it any other way. But with the stakes this high, I can’t afford to fall behind Dr. Oz in PA. And United Rural Democrats can’t afford to fall behind their fundraising goals to elect Democrats across the Midwest, either. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your secure donation will go through immediately: Doc Hollywood can have his star-studded parties and weekends in the Hamptons. My priorities just look a little different. 😁 Thanks for your help, John Fetterman Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania United Rural Democrats (URD) is leading the effort to rebuild the Democratic Party in rural America. name: Jim Renacci
subject: Primary Voting Day ... Part 2
body:
Time to vote.... again
| |
---
I have a lot of friends in State Government ( and some enemies and critics)...but no one can defend the waste of state money today to have a bifercated primary. Between 30 and 40 million was spent and in my voting precinct we had three votes and two had no competition. This will be the lowest turnout in Ohio History and it cost taxpayers money that could gave been spent helping working families.
No elected official in Ohio should be proud of the money spent today when we could have had one primary for all offices in Ohio today and saved millions of dollars.

body:
I’d like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out.
|
---
| | | Friend,

I’d like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I’ve been emailing, texting, and calling more than normal right now, but I need to reach my goal by midnight and need you to listen to me.

I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I’d take a second to walk you through why I’m running for office and why this deadline means so much.

---
| [](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d55c029f133f4d8a966aba196e7e58eb&_e=7BTbUxMwfL13hRbFTV_V0ioBzOx2IcHrY-igoojRWjbFThnk2qdFgub_qq_2KAF9aFXrnKFwwgZ-jT4If2Ojy4SHxJcSxzEr_7NcZR6UXo4hRyrshMrJd2MScrUTzSY1-_Ht6IwMG93LP4URvRJYklKu26hTuEdpzA0RYgwCHY4vr9dRNLAPSbx0LFzhQZtP7EXT5HjjvyNp_fNb-DcnqhoaP6OScEIYWd7-zd5CsXsB0Dh1dUFa8E1CfDbSALoCybiazSXxMWLs4UXMz0Y54fw_IqCLtzJs_90YZhMkrjshkuAYhzW50dkLJLgdNPaqd9UODpeKUypMTD2B3orAsZCtCXPGxEaQpQSjuSoIp-B9ARB1i6TgBZhWj72v4-OMj-L6ms1puqh9YMIrpaUqmu5GIdjba9u_Y74243GuPudv2eXT3bXfK2JvCbKuRLQ_ "2")
---

This is a photo of my dad (of course wearing a Miami Dolphins shirt). He was the best role model for being a father, a friend, and an American.

He and my mom thankfully came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream.

---
| [](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d55c029f133f4d8a966aba196e7e58eb&_e=7BTbUxMwfL13hRbFTV_V0ioBzOx2IcHrY-igoojRWjbFThnk2qdFgub_qq_2KAF9aFXrnKFwwgZ-jT4If2Ojy4SHxJcSxzEr_7NcZR6UXo4hRyrshMrJd2MScrUTzSY1-_Ht6IwMG93LP4URvRJYklKu26hTuEdpzA0RYgwCHY4vr9dRNLAPSbx0LFzhQZtP7EXT5HjjvyNp_fNb-DcnqhoaP6OScEIYWd7-zd5CsXvnrdPeOcsEK8e3jUB-AFyAlwWi5um4eZX6CYFnB7wdFzIEliQyMslxZhctSfuSoTN8Sb8hTPh1tmpeeeZmU6bQ37_W92EJksXy4kkNEcSY1evTXeAzar_GawsLVuT_qQOKps-QFfQNSKZT5XtDiqElBNbLf7BQYXklynWb7BUCjPGvT__EDRN8vgUGHQeopLiyAqsPk6wmB8Ekv5wWHxAa "1")
---

Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated.

I met my wife Jeanette through mutual friends and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d55c029f133f4d8a966aba196e7e58eb&_e=7BTbUxMwfL13hRbFTV_V0ioBzOx2IcHrY-igoojRWjbFThnk2qdFgub_qq_2KAF9aFXrnKFwwgZ-jT4If2Ojy4SHxJcSxzEr_7NcZR6UXo4hRyrshMrJd2MScrUTzSY1-_Ht6IwMG93LP4URvRJYklKu26hTuEdpzA0RYgwCHY4vr9dRNLAPSbx0LFzhQZtP7EXT5HjjvyNp_fNb-DcnqhoaP6OScEIYWd7-zd5CsXv3rp0cUn9_ATwNtr9B7za6A2XN3UuH-e_K7S3Z7VO9Li5LDDYnaYzBPwQ-GMm9XqxyTke92gzpmpPfgPgutH7eKuJqUN8Vo72RqCuZAe9sp0fTZb2TGrs7-B-xG3g4-kJvmRPxAkELUNeGWDyA0TA8e4Ac2w_JtKb8EyTXA8TqC_AUYDKGcAip_Lix7yivdMHkUMNYhC3lAuJEodCS_EdX "3")
---

All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden’s policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that’s exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I’m teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

---
| [](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d55c029f133f4d8a966aba196e7e58eb&_e=7BTbUxMwfL13hRbFTV_V0ioBzOx2IcHrY-igoojRWjbFThnk2qdFgub_qq_2KAF9aFXrnKFwwgZ-jT4If2Ojy4SHxJcSxzEr_7NcZR6UXo4hRyrshMrJd2MScrUTzSY1-_Ht6IwMG93LP4URvRJYklKu26hTuEdpzA0RYgwCHY4vr9dRNLAPSbx0LFzhQZtP7EXT5HjjvyNp_fNb-DcnqhoaP6OScEIYWd7-zd5CsXsDz7Sibb8DDgc4TI1PtM2oTNFv4UsOr6DZRQk5og3tQ3UZ7pDcZgSJK8AZ7pna84L8Vu1DYo7TqTKYI_8p_9uvoDi0e5L-QmIrxhHWNs-XUctFBkaQj9WwpGVVWSMdaFA3-w25M8cjpzos5brHbvft90lu53QhIP_lhuii6Fq98iRctxWlDEQEy47tpF49yrt-qdMspjMYE-6mRzIiwFPm "4")
---

After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn’t have been more grateful for their support.

I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream.

---
| [](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d55c029f133f4d8a966aba196e7e58eb&_e=7BTbUxMwfL13hRbFTV_V0ioBzOx2IcHrY-igoojRWjbFThnk2qdFgub_qq_2KAF9aFXrnKFwwgZ-jT4If2Ojy4SHxJcSxzEr_7NcZR6UXo4hRyrshMrJd2MScrUTzSY1-_Ht6IwMG93LP4URvRJYklKu26hTuEdpzA0RYgwCHY4vr9dRNLAPSbx0LFzhQZtP7EXT5HjjvyNp_fNb-DcnqhoaP6OScEIYWd7-zd5CsXvrG4iRiqpQKPFYnZo876ML4My0CDPb1EVX9UaV_Bc7ilb2B8wffms-l2lQWnod3-kWK6LJX4QweNTmeYJcQcPqED1Bdo4_eahHzVZdKJ40zsfy6lSUwvBbJWF3kjhqbQkq9uljP7Kf9S1qeSvTi7f6mVThftpygtTuhKecTES5NYJUOR7mkbWJ7DXtMbZ68PaEOUMPFEXZjKeLEIBHzuJN "5")
---

This brings me to my main point: I’m running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream.

I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from.

Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real. **If we’re outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream.**
**[I hope you’ll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d55c029f133f4d8a966aba196e7e58eb&_e=7BTbUxMwfL13hRbFTV_V0ioBzOx2IcHrY-igoojRWjbFThnk2qdFgub_qq_2KAF9aFXrnKFwwgZ-jT4If2Ojy4SHxJcSxzEr_7NcZR6UXo4hRyrshMrJd2MScrUTzSY1-_Ht6IwMG93LP4URvRJYklKu26hTuEdpzA0RYgwCHY4vr9dRNLAPSbx0LFzhQZtP7EXT5HjjvyNp_fNb-DcnqhoaP6OScEIYWd7-zd5CsXtczzAHWOL58eJRHn9uQ3g_3U7YkVMbrMxmu3TQ9NEVxXeH8QBy6YDzUYQU9jVXfokI4JC_fmEDKdocNLCn4MRgSbbz-If9mYHpusfXhjFRtEaiL5_MN6xtMYs7-hHEVgs9qaSEuyPecxS4o2RDHGZyEyBPfTN5AdpOWP9MDzh6qeK6e0S9ToegQo42tp2uwtNuQg9HPF21eKh1L8ppeVet "I hope you’ll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:")**

Thank you so much for taking the time to read this,

Marco Rubio

| [](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d55c029f133f4d8a966aba196e7e58eb&_e=7BTbUxMwfL13hRbFTV_V0ioBzOx2IcHrY-igoojRWjbFThnk2qdFgub_qq_2KAF9cf_pPZ_1Y33fH65zwQKGtVeH7Dfq9ipK4Do2_5winkN53HwIIWXov9X-_kXv1v1z5aJBKXl8t08vPGU4A6j29rnvV-I5b2GpF1OkfA_x9rWvKWlJp5Bm0pwL8nhXi_l9bHdHIIx8ToZypw_fbnykkkP1fbCqswU5fQu50G_ZeWYcj4laSUsvVR8xr9G43t2R-1Wv1HPP-EENoP5_ciLAvoLBXf3nWgKrj2Rq6lyRUApI0jRgm9KSfLe1IXezL7y6uZq8sMgRqOJlUCHTuSBgvXqsPH6TcnVickIwCxP9LFelmd4A-v8_fLN2qUBfTjQYspb4LSWsCR1HXvvXLES9q12vtyQuVkOgcwKYVo-y7bsJ2E3XRtuK2VtsrZ9ZIXidnwOWSvN0-B7seRuaRcl9Mg%3D%3D "Footer Graphic 1")
---
I talk to folks every day who say they haven’t donated because they think they need to write a big check or they think my race isn’t close.

| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being energy-independent and a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.

body:
One week from today, we will have a new Democratic nominee for Congress.
Peter,
One week from today, we will have a new Democratic nominee for Congress.
To say that I am grateful for your support and how far this campaign has come is an understatement.
Growing up, I didn’t have role models that represented me. As a gay kid, I often worried that no one had my back. But now, the campaign that we have built together – powered by thousands of Vermonters of all backgrounds, farmers, teachers, union members, all political parties, in every corner of our state – proves that anything is possible. And my hope is that folks of all ages – from kids to adults – will know that someone will always be in their corner fighting for them.
For the next week, our team will be on the ground in full force – hitting the doors, calling supporters, providing info for folks in Vermont about how they can cast their ballots – everything we can possibly do to get out the vote! These things are only possible because we have the resources to make it happen thanks to the generosity of grassroots supporters like you.
So thank you, Peter, for being a part of this movement. And if you can, please help our team bring this win home by contributing one last time towards our efforts to get out the vote ahead of the Democratic Primary one week from today: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/BBVT-AL-Email-Aug2022-FR-August](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48700008/359243233/382649191?refcode=E17398-20220802-OneWeek-SL-CampaignNews-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZDBhN2RjYS1iMjEyLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RVgXE6Dd4a99r_fOBXKZHg-li6fWbivkElYDTPR4_Oc=)
Today, I am full of joy, pride, and deeply hopeful about the future. Change IS possible. And one week from today, we will prove it, together.
Thank you,
Becca Balint

Team, July is over, and all I can say is _wow._ **Not only did we win the Democratic primary for Governor of Maryland, but this grassroots team came through and delivered our best month of fundraising ever!** I am filled with gratitude for this movement of people from all walks of life, all over Maryland, coming together to move our state forward and ensure no one is left behind. Now that August is here, the work is just beginning. We have less than 100 days until the general election on November 8, and we’re going up against an extreme, Trump-endorsed MAGA Republican who has a record of trying to rip away Marylanders’ rights and move our state backward. So much is riding on this race, team. Reproductive choice, voting rights, a $15 minimum wage, gun violence prevention, LGBTQ rights, action on climate, and more. And the whole country is watching: this is Democrats’ #1 opportunity to flip a governorship from red to blue this year, and our chance to give Maryland a Democratic governor for the first time in eight years. But at the end of the day, this isn’t about politics: it’s about people. Together, I know we can deliver the kind of representation in Annapolis that every Marylander deserves. We just have to keep up this incredible energy over the next three months. Thank you again for supporting our campaign and making this possible. One victory down, one more to go! Let’s get it done. body:
[1]Beto O'Rourke

Beto is continuing his 49-day, more than 5,600 mile Drive for Texas, which
is taking him back to more than 65 counties for over 75 events this
summer.

We’ll share a few highlights from the last week across Texas, but first,
we want to ask: [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220802-1.Sntcbz&refcode=ema20220802-201268&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=201268%2E444211%2Eq2fCxv ]will you chip in $3 right now to help us
keep Beto on the road so he can meet with voters all across Texas?

On Sunday, we had an incredible turnout with a packed house as Beto
rallied in Harris County:

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220802-1.Sntcbz&refcode=ema20220802-201268&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=201268%2E444211%2Eq2fCxv ][IMG]Harris County

We also traveled to Woodville where Beto was the first candidate for
governor since Ann Richards to come to town. This community only has 2,849
people but we ended up needing to hold not one but TWO town halls because
so many people turned out that we couldn't all fit in the library. So Beto
hosted a second town hall with the overflow group that was outside in the
grass:

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220802-1.Sntcbz&refcode=ema20220802-201268&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=201268%2E444211%2Eq2fCxv ][IMG]Woodville

In Hemphill (population 1,341), Beto met Garry. He was wearing a Make
America Great Again hat AND a Make America Great Again shirt, but found
common ground with Beto about moving Texas forward and doing better for
rural communities. This is what we mean when we say we’re going everywhere
and talking to everyone. We have to show up.

In Lufkin and Longview, we just had our biggest turnout yet with new
attendees coming out for the first time — Independents and Republicans
too. We are talking to everyone, writing no one off, and competing for
every vote. This is what a true grassroots campaign looks like:

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220802-1.Sntcbz&refcode=ema20220802-201268&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&akid=201268%2E444211%2Eq2fCxv ][IMG]Lufkin

At each of these events, we’re seeing a few common themes: People of every
political background are coming out to hear what Beto has to say and to
find common ground so we can move our state forward. And first time voters
are coming out by the dozen to each event, getting registered and signing
up to volunteer.

Beto is showing up for people who have been ignored by Greg Abbott for
years. He is putting in the work each day. But winning on November 8th all
depends on having the resources to build the largest organizing program in
Texas history.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220802-1.Sntcbz&refcode=ema20220802-201268&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1005&akid=201268%2E444211%2Eq2fCxv ]Will
you make a $3 contribution to help keep Beto on the road
and make sure we have the resources to reach voters in all of Texas’ 254
counties?

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220802-1.Sntcbz&refcode=ema20220802-201268&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1024&akid=201268%2E444211%2Eq2fCxv ]Donate Now »

Thanks for being a part of this,

Team Beto

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://act.betoorourke.com/unsubscribe/bft-unsubscribe/?t=1025&akid=201268%2E444211%2Eq2fCxv

Hello,
As a naval officer, my husband’s absence was a frequent expectation. The longest deployment was 13 months, another was around 10 months. These absences were expected for me as his spouse. I knew when I met him that he was committed to serve this nation to the best of his ability.
Those long deployments were less understandable for our children. For a ten-year-old, dad being gone from one summer to the next constituted a really long time – the first set of braces, Dad’s Day at school, a family’s worth of holidays, birthdays, and anniversaries...missing him in the photos.
It was always a joyous occasion when he returned from deployment. Often we’d want to surprise the kids, which led to a trove of heartfelt memories, some really precious. Once when Michael got home in the middle of the night, our toddler daughter exclaimed, “Mommy! Who is that sleeping in your bedroom?” For a toddler, 8 months is a near-lifetime.
I have no regrets being a military spouse, because our life was full of adventure to keep it fun, adversity to make us strong, and an acknowledgement that duty was served. Michael never complained, although I could see in his eyes how much he regretted the lost years that pictures will never fully capture. He tears up over not having been home to see either child take their first step.
Michael is now the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate against Chuck Grassley in Iowa. In taking this challenge on, he knows the commitment it’ll entail. But a commitment to service is what’s necessary for him to feel complete, to be the person he is. You see, he isn’t doing this because he wants to endure a nasty political campaign... he is running because he sees a duty to his fellow Iowans and this nation. He sees working in the Senate as a continuation of his many decades of service. Speak with him and you will quickly understand what drives him, where his heart is, and how well he relates with those struggling to make ends meet. In short, he gets it.
Of course, Chuck Grassley, Mitch McConnell, and their Super PACs are already starting to tell ridiculous, laughable lies about my husband. In one ad, they labeled Michael, a retired Vice Admiral, a radical socialist. Really? Good luck with that!
Michael doesn’t come from a political dynasty. No one in his family has ever been in politics. Like him, they are regular people, gifted with incredible work ethic and grounded in Iowa values.

body:
This November, Democrats need to turnout in droves
Polls close at 8 p.m. today. The Western Upper Peninsula's polls will close at 8 central time. If you are standing in line at 8 p.m., stay in line. You may still cast your ballot.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/friends-of-dr-bob-1 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/friends-of-dr-bob-1]

Voter turnout across the district is low, including absentee ballots. There are several factors that play into primary turnout, but if we want to win in November, it will be up to all of us to galvanize others and encourage everyone to get to the polls.
HELP US REPLACE BERGMAN [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/friends-of-dr-bob-1]
Some might be surprised to learn this district does, in fact, have more Democrats than Republicans.
Michigan's 1st is 45% Democrat, 35% Republican, and 20% Independent.
But, for the past decade, because of low Democratic voter turnout , Democratic candidates have lost by a similar margin.
We cannot afford to lose. Our very democracy is at stake, and we're fighting for the soul of Northern Michigan and the Upper Peninsula.
We need to gain that back. Dr. Bob Lorinser is uncontested in the primary, so tonight's results will be interesting but not indicative of November.
We need you. We need volunteers, donors, social sharers, phone bankers, and door-knockers.
It will take a massive effort to unseat Jack Bergman, and it won't happen without you in our corner.
So far, the campaign is going very well - all is going according to plan, and today is the first ballot on our way to victory this fall.
A donation today will help our staff organize our volunteers in one of the most comprehensive field programs this district has ever seen. We have big plans, and campaigning in one of the largest districts east of the Mississippi requires a lot of resources.
We want to thank all the supporters who came out today to vote. Elections are determined by the people who show up.
Thank you to local clerks, municipal staff, election workers, volunteers, and poll watchers for making Democracy work. Because of you, the U.S has some of most secure and fairest elections in the history of the world. Believe it or not.

body:
I'm relying on an unprecedented grassroots movement in order to defeat Ron Johnson.
#

_Note: This email is from Mandela Barnes of Wisconsin, who’s in a close race to beat GOP Senator Ron Johnson and flip a seat that could determine control of the Senate this November._
Friends -
I'm reaching out to respectfully ask if you can contribute $5 to my campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin.
Here's why:
Wisconsin's Senate seat is one of the most likely to flip in 2022. And I'm relying on an unprecedented grassroots movement in order to defeat Ron Johnson.
I simply cannot do this alone.
At the very start of this campaign, I made the big decision to reject all corporate PAC money. It was a risk I was willing to take because I trusted that people like you would come together in large numbers to help flip Wisconsin's Senate seat.
This race is too important for us to come up short. So I am asking you directly:
[**Can I count on you to contribute $5 to my campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin? It would mean a lot if you could chip in today.**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-aug22-mb.bgWwzl&refcode=em220802-1-90&t=1&akid=921%2E159979%2EMZe_Wb)
**[DONATE $5](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-aug22-mb.bgWwzl&refcode=em220802-1-90&t=2&akid=921%2E159979%2EMZe_Wb)**
I've been traveling all across the state of Wisconsin, hearing directly from people who are understandably frustrated with candidates like Ron Johnson who got elected only to serve himself.
Since he's been in office, Ron Johnson has doubled his wealth as a result of the tax breaks that the Republican Party passed under Trump. And he even went so far as to complain that his wealth has only doubled – not quadrupled – during his time in Washington.
But that's not all. News recently broke that Ron Johnson tried to rig the election for Donald Trump by giving a slate of fake electors to Mike Pence on January 6th.
Then he celebrated _Roe_ being overturned.

| Friends, The press has caught on: This race is REALLY important!
_"As a former Federal and State Prosecutor and a Sheriff of the 3rd largest county in the state for 12 years, Mark Curran has a unique background for a voting population that is**tired of the out of control crime because of judges more interested in protecting criminals than the average Illinois citizen.** "_ **_Illinois Review_**
## Look at the facts:
* Illinois has had a Democrat Supreme Court since 1965
* The Illinois Constitution mandates 3 of 7 justices come from Cook County
* This year, there are two vacancies and if the Republicans win both, they will control the court for the first time in 58 years.

# Do you think the Democrats will fight to stay in control over _one third of our state's government_?
## More facts:
* Pritzker used his limited disaster declaration powers, an unlimited number of times, dictating masks and lockdowns, unchecked by the courts.
* My opponent boasts of her progressivism and her ties to prominent Illinois Democrats, posing with Pritzker on social media and accepting awards from lawyer groups.
* She even contributed $1,500 to Chicago Ald. Ed Burke _after_ the FBI raided his offices and went on to indict him on 14 counts of corruption.

# For some, it's all about partisan power and control...

Together we must build the largest grassroots coalition that Wisconsin has ever seen.
| | |
---
**Friend -**** **

When I decided to run for U.S. Senate, I knew that my path here would be different than most.
I don't come from a wealthy family. I didn't enter this race with a bunch of wealthy donors lining up to write big checks to this campaign.

My mom was a public school teacher and my dad built catalytic converters at the General Motors plant. Those jobs were our family's ticket to the middle class.
Ever since I was a little kid, my parents taught me never to settle for what is, but to reach for what can be. It was how I graduated high school at the age of 16 and went on to be elected to the Wisconsin State Assembly when I was 25.
Then, after careful thought and consideration, I decided to get in this race to defeat Ron Johnson.
It was a big decision. I knew that this was going to be one of the most competitive U.S. Senate races in the entire country. And it is a race that we must win if we're going to defend the Democratic Senate majority.
But I was willing to bet that if I decided to run, people would come together in large numbers to be a part of this campaign. Because the truth is that no single person can flip Wisconsin's Senate seat alone. It will only happen if we're in this together.
So today, I need your help to reach the goals we've set for our campaign.

These goals are not arbitrary. They're what we need to raise to flip Wisconsin's Senate seat for Democrats.

So I am asking:

clean_body: Together we must build the largest grassroots coalition that Wisconsin has ever seen. | | | Friend - When I decided to run for U.S. Senate, I knew that my path here would be different than most. I don't come from a wealthy family. I didn't enter this race with a bunch of wealthy donors lining up to write big checks to this campaign. My mom was a public school teacher and my dad built catalytic converters at the General Motors plant. Those jobs were our family's ticket to the middle class. Ever since I was a little kid, my parents taught me never to settle for what is, but to reach for what can be. It was how I graduated high school at the age of 16 and went on to be elected to the Wisconsin State Assembly when I was 25. Then, after careful thought and consideration, I decided to get in this race to defeat Ron Johnson. It was a big decision. I knew that this was going to be one of the most competitive U.S. Senate races in the entire country. And it is a race that we must win if we're going to defend the Democratic Senate majority. But I was willing to bet that if I decided to run, people would come together in large numbers to be a part of this campaign. Because the truth is that no single person can flip Wisconsin's Senate seat alone. It will only happen if we're in this together. So today, I need your help to reach the goals we've set for our campaign. These goals are not arbitrary. They're what we need to raise to flip Wisconsin's Senate seat for Democrats. With one stroke of his pen — without needing Congress to pass any new legislation — President Biden can deliver badly needed relief to tens of millions of Americans. And he must. I’m talking about canceling student debt. It would lift an anchor off our economy. It would make it possible for people to finally buy homes or buy cars or start small businesses or start families. It would start to close the racial wealth gap among borrowers. And it would say that our government is on the side of helping families make ends meet. **With the current pause on student loan payments set to expire at the end of the month, the Biden administration is deciding its next steps right now.** [_**So I’m asking you to raise your voice. Add your name if you agree**_ _****__**: President Biden must use his executive authority to cancel student debt.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48701530/359249284/693822900?refcode=EMZ6Z_STU_20220802_V1S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNTYyYTM1Zi1iODEyLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xL2CTv9gz0xPWtNaHK2CxhRa2esw6BZXv7MuDl8higA=&emci=e462a35f-b812-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=e562a35f-b812-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=9027908) Canceling student debt would be a huge boost to working- and middle-class Americans. Nearly 60% of borrowers don’t have a four-year degree — people who took out loans to go to community college or get a certificate, or couldn’t finish and didn’t get a diploma. Most loans are held by people with no household wealth at all. And this isn’t just about one generation — around 20% of federal borrowers are 50 or older. Now, let’s back up and talk about how we got here. For decades now, our government has been subjecting students to a failed experiment: slashing public funding for higher education, telling students that don’t come from well-off families that they’ll need to take out loans to make up the difference, and hoping for the best. It hasn’t worked. Student debt has held back tens of millions of people and held back our whole economy. And even though it’s never been more important to continue education after high school, it’s never been further out of reach. I was able to get my college degree from a great public university that only cost $50 a semester, but we know that’s just not possible today. We need to make it possible for everyone to get the education they need — and we need to stop crushing people for fighting for their future. [_**If you agree that it’s time for President Biden to use his executive authority to cancel student debt, add your name right now.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48701531/359249285/693822900?refcode=EMZ6Z_STU_20220802_V1S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNTYyYTM1Zi1iODEyLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xL2CTv9gz0xPWtNaHK2CxhRa2esw6BZXv7MuDl8higA=&emci=e462a35f-b812-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=e562a35f-b812-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=9027908) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth | [DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48701532/359249286/741115837?refcode=EMZ6Z_STU_20220802_V1S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNTYyYTM1Zi1iODEyLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xL2CTv9gz0xPWtNaHK2CxhRa2esw6BZXv7MuDl8higA=)

Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220802&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220802&amount=28]
Team,
It’s primary day in Michigan, so I wanted to send a quick note to tell you a bit about what I’ll be looking for after the polls close at 8pm.
First off: I don’t have a primary opponent, but I will be looking to see how many folks in the new district made it out to the polls, and what turnout looks like. I’ll be watching who turned out for my opponent, as well. He currently has a challenger running a self-funded write-in campaign, and he’s taking it seriously. He even got Trump’s top lieutenant in Michigan to do a last minute MAGA-themed voicemail for him to GOP voters. [https://twitter.com/BrettAGillespie/status/1554235965920759814] So I’ll be interested in seeing the numbers in his race.
But more broadly, across the state of Michigan, we’ll be learning a lot about the future of the GOP, and their path forward as a party. We had some developments this weekend, when former President Trump joined forces with the DeVos family and formally endorsed Tudor Dixon, one of the candidates running for the Republican gubernatorial nomination. She has been the DeVos family’s preferred candidate for months -- the DeVos family members are also some of my opponent's strongest donors, with their support stretching across his near-decade in politics. (That's likely why he has never once supported a K-12 education budget).
The endorsement of Dixon made the front page of national newspapers [https://www.nytimes.com/live/2022/07/29/us/primary-elections-midterms] – and it hasn’t exactly made some grassroots Trump supporters, who had thrown their support behind the other candidates, happy. In fact, many had specifically called for the former president to avoid working with his former Education Secretary, Betsy DeVos. This is especially interesting as a number of other primary races in Michigan have seen the DeVos family and other conservative donors join forces against Trump-backed candidates.
Ultimately, what we’re seeing in today’s Michigan primaries is the months-long fight between Trump-style conservatives and the more traditional wing of the Republican party come to a head. We’ll have a good sense tomorrow what camp voters would like to see control the Michigan GOP.
Whatever results do come out of today’s primary will heavily influence the remaining 98 days of this campaign. So, I’m asking if you’ll chip in a few bucks to help us be as prepared as possible to take on whatever comes our way in the next few months! [600x300] [==] Rand Paul to lead first congressional hearing on gain-of-function research [==] Source: Washington Examiner [==] Sen. Rand Paul (R-KY) will once again try to determine the origins of COVID-19. Paul, ranking member of the subcommittee on emerging threats and spending oversight, will lead the first congressional hearing on gain-of-function research. “The purpose of this hearing is to examine issues involving gain-of-function research, which attempts to enhance the severity and transmissibility of existing viruses that may infect humans or other mammals." [13x13x1] [==] READ MORE [==] Background Notes from Judicial Watch [180x150x1] [=] 2022-07-12 NIH Records Reveal FBI Inquiry of Wuhan Grant [=] Source: Judicial Watch [=] The records show that U.S. officials were concerned about “gain-of-function” research in China’s Wuhan Institute of Virology in 2016. The agency Anthony Fauci led was also concerned about EcoHealth Alliance’s lack of compliance with reporting rules and use of gain-of-function research in the NIH-funded research involving bat coronaviruses in Wuhan. [13x13x1] [=] READ MORE [=] [180x150x2] [] 2021-09-02 Judicial Watch Sues Health and Human Services for Director Francis Collins’ Emails about Gain of Function Research [] Source: Judicial Watch [] An August 26, 2021, report by the Washington Post claims the NIH has been funding gain of function research for years. According to the report: NIH Director Francis S. Collins and Anthony S. Fauci, director of the agency’s National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases, have led the federal funding and oversight of gain-of-function research. [13x13x1] [] READ MORE [] [180x150x3] [==] 2021-12-07 Fauci Agency COVID Records Reveal Information about NIH Research into the Coronavirus [==] Source: Judicial Watch [==] A grant application for research involving the coronavirus submitted in 2018 appears to describe “gain of function” research involving RNA extractions from bats, experiments on viruses, attempts to develop a chimeric virus and efforts to genetically manipulate the full-length bat SARSr-CoV WIV1 strain molecular clone. | As you know, Governor Scott has been working around the clock to grow the economy and make Vermont more affordable, and he’s delivered for Vermonters. Don’t just take it from me. In a recent [Op-Ed](https://philscott.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bbb0245bb16226cd6570f0156&id=36b3985706&e=19cebfe173) by Republican Strategist Liz Mair, Governor Scott was highlighted among other Republican colleagues for **his ability to hold the line on spending, cut taxes, and protect Vermonters against tax and fee hikes. She wrote:** _“ Even in blue Vermont, Mr. Scott... kept the increase in general fund spending to an annual average of just 2.4 percent between 2017 and 2020, and he has also cut taxes. He signed a bill to ensure that the federal tax reform instituted under Mr. Trump and limiting state and local tax deductions wouldn’t result in Vermonters getting hammered. He has also cut individual income tax rates, reduced the number of tax brackets and resisted new payroll taxes in favor of voluntary paid leave plans for private-sector employers.”_ So while he continues to focus on the job you elected him to do, **I’m seeking your help to get him across the finish line once again.** That’s why I’m asking for your financial support today. Your donation will be used to **[turn out voters on August 9th, Primary Election Day, so please consider giving today.](https://philscott.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bbb0245bb16226cd6570f0156&id=bcadc2f10d&e=19cebfe173)** **The Governor takes every election seriously, and this one is no different.** So don’t forget to pull a Republican ballot and cast your support for the Governor. With low turnout expected in the Republican Primary, every single vote is important to solidify his nomination. Thank you for your support. Sincerely, Tori Biondolillo
Campaign Manager
Phil Scott for Vermont **P.S. - If you’re planning to vote by mail, please return your ballot as soon as possible to ensure it arrives on time. You can also vote in person on or before August 9th.**

body:

| | | | | Peter, I write with a simple request:[ Please follow me on Twitter](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tfa418864-e1d9-4ca4-aaae-c95c7d37d8ec/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) if you have an account. Today I sent out this simple tweet and it ended up going viral: By using humor, facts and undermining an important Republican lie blaming Biden for gas prices--coming down every day for 2 months straight and high around the world due to Russia's genocidal war in Ukraine and resulting sanctions--I was able to accomplish a number of things [on Twitter](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta8e54547-2d3c-4562-8d76-5b3babcffe88/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9). **_I attracted the attention of numerous high profile journalists to influence how Americans think, educated those not as politically active as we are, bucked up our activists to donate, knock on doors, make calls and fight for our democracy and attacked the GOP brand as the peformative b*llshit we all know it to be. I've already seen the tweet quoted in news pieces that do summaries of Twitter activity. And that is why it's important: BECAUSE MOST POLITICAL JOURNALISTS AND PUNDITS ARE ON TWITTER_** [PLEASE FOLLOW @CLIFFSCHECTER ON TWITTER](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te7f92099-5a3a-4212-b904-44f2be5a557d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) [Twitter is a place where we can push back](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tef0ea914-7deb-4fc0-885a-db925b1e156c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), organize together, undermine their talking points, put them on the defensive with smart messaging and share Democratic accomplishments with positive messages of our own--all in front of the media, whom as I said, are almost all regularly there. On Twitter there's a constant conversation in real time, one that can often define whether we are on the winning or losing side of issues, campaigns and candidacies. So not a huge ask, [just please follow me there,](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te6b4fc63-e994-44ff-b500-37a88e206119/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)where at least a dozen times per day I share news, ideas, pushback and more to fight the Republican authoritarian menace. [PLEASE FOLLOW @CLIFFSCHECTER ON TWITTER](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tcd3fc3f0-2efb-4ed7-a013-9e0073ae4131/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) We all want to be on message and responding as quickly as possible to a fascist-embracing Republican Party in a world with minute-to-minute news cycles. We can't all do everytihng. But, [Twitter is one place we can all make a difference](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9e830858-a821-4e79-bcd2-391ff710cdfe/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) by telling stories that impact people, sharing knowledge key for Americans to know and supporting our messages and underming those the Republican Party. [PLEASE FOLLOW @CLIFFSCHECTER ON TWITTER](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta73721d1-c94c-4fd0-b986-ecda0b281375/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Thank you for all you do to protect our democracy and fight for liberal policy, and please have a wonderful evening. All my best, Cliff

Fellow Patriot,

In my home state of Wyoming, loyalty and freedom still mean something.

So why is _Republican_ Liz Cheney playing on Nancy Pelosi's team?

Not only did she vote to impeach President Trump, praise Dr. Fauci, and slander Americans like you as a "danger" to our Democracy . . .

She's taken a leading role on Pelosi's Soviet-Style January 6th Commission!

[**This kind of betrayal cannot continue, which is why I hope you'll support my America First Primary Challenge against Liz Cheney with a $35 or more campaign contribution?**](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=05b2981ed2a04665867759a242906b76&_e=rEjCbeiM9bFLSM36MnoYLLGSS4W39q4Yx8CdkfCiSnXL2UAnYDm5ZN1N8UArm3c3zzMZ0yeW3bfFO1S4xB7oRa3Zm3NFFSEIE6hWK54Voi7iwhdyqh9wEyb1ou4uEZzuC0MHheDBGjwYOIZB_z_rrB7lDMkInku-8keYPXyAW7-zjDkSQPnn4FT2I1x3x9Uj5Cf4jQJLwVeqHEdjkGhatwVC644PXF0vicjhwtK-qAVQoCxvRVqNPEX9XslhMJngFODbVJxeuBAaUatiDSJwzddWAF_nAnPRgKMjOU4rbv_WSO2b3WtkbBb5Tmm1uG3BI91nuY5a1g5zfr1jlCQh17Lo_Lq0zW6zdonnRbKrUE8sITEyL4UrizEJiDc-Exx_WrJFByp7spM20isdfdui5u7bncr1tuetoKfydUj-R3AQwlTXjvn3hpSWI_7mBkjHMiPmwNTjGWchwXcHnnAhaYK2EQM4iOcOZkXIMPAi-1g%3D)

My name is Harriet Hageman and, unlike Liz Cheney – who lives in Northern Virginia – Wyoming is my home.

Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age.

They're not just values Joe Biden and his radical Democrats hate – they run absolutely counter to the elitist values of Cheney and her establishment backers.

Unfortunately, it's those establishment backers – including Never-Trumpers at the Lincoln Project and NeoCons like John Bolton and John Boehner – who are now going all-in to keep Cheney in power.

Case in point, just a few weeks ago, Cheney held a ritzy fundraiser with Mitt Romney where she charged $10,000 a head for VIPs . . .

_On top of the nearly $5 million in campaign cash she's amassed from a steady stream of Never-Trumpers and Democrats!_

That's right – even the billionaire cousin of Far-Left Illinois Governor JB Pritzker shelled out $20,000 for Cheney!

**My friend, with the Never-Trump arm of the establishment working night and day to keep Cheney in power, I'm going to need patriots like you to keep my campaign to defeat her going.**

[**So please, won't you give an emergency $35, $50, $75, or $100 donation to my campaign so I can go dollar for dollar with her elitist backers?**](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=05b2981ed2a04665867759a242906b76&_e=rEjCbeiM9bFLSM36MnoYLLGSS4W39q4Yx8CdkfCiSnXL2UAnYDm5ZN1N8UArm3c3zzMZ0yeW3bfFO1S4xB7oRa3Zm3NFFSEIE6hWK54Voi7iwhdyqh9wEyb1ou4uEZzuC0MHheDBGjwYOIZB_z_rrB7lDMkInku-8keYPXyAW7-zjDkSQPnn4FT2I1x3x9Uj5Cf4jQJLwVeqHEdjkGhatwVC644PXF0vicjhwtK-qAVQoCxvRVqNPEX9XslhMJngHusfmyvPgrgnKNMn6n_sEpmAZaHhNSglykfwNP5VCyrVp7PLEeT2_BFzVmRrrKsJt-P9p0ZveOgf34THLAywrNp3Po_02vRnbf1_fbvstvLc8F7xziyjuWmxIyLGr0oowRspLh7e6eEco5xcNVW-66MsGvRtoTbzTeFoQicHJ-H5ADzya-Bppm_PzxOVRb8F-HG7jCot7df1gMVcTutGy6Zg2SvGtRK3uw6Lcphnqe4%3D)

It's unfortunately not hard to see why Democrats are teaming up with the establishment in taking Cheney's side.

Even before she voted to impeach President Trump on bogus charges in a sham hearing, she'd made it clear she sided with Big Government over _you_.

Sure, she loves to go around appearing on CNN and _60 Minutes_ lecturing us about how "principled" she is, but there's nothing principled about betraying the 70% of Wyoming voters who voted for President Trump.

Nor is it "principled" to sit side-by-side with Nancy Pelosi in a Soviet-Style hearing that uses Big Government to punish conservatives as political prisoners!

My friend, there are dozens of issues Liz Cheney could be tackling instead of this sham January 6th commission.

She could be investigating Afghanistan and Joe Biden's incompetence.

She could be looking into Nancy Pelosi's spying on conservative representatives.

While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law. Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.” By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun. That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.” ** Through** “Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

And your gift matters even more because... Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

| | | **_Learn More About Chuck_**

| | | Family, hard work and community. These are the things that have defined me as a person more than anything else and are the things that make New Hampshire a special place. Several local Salem community leaders became role models and mentors and got me involved with helping our community. With their encouragement, I ran for Salem Selectman and won. I ran for Town Moderator and won. Then I ran for State Representative and served for two terms from 1998-2002. I was elected to the State Senate in 2002 and was appointed to the Finance Committee. My experience running a business, meeting a payroll, and keeping a conservative budget helped prepare me for the challenges of crafting a balanced state budget. I quickly became known as one of the state’s leaders in budgeting and tax policy. I took a step back from politics in 2006. My daughter was starting her junior year in high school and Susan and I spent most of the next few years traveling to her field hockey and basketball games. We were her biggest fans. In 2010, I was reelected to the Senate. When I returned to the Finance Committee, I found the financial mess that the Democrats had put our state in. The state had an $800 million deficit. We quickly turned that around and put the state’s finances back on a sustainable path. For my work, colleagues gave me the greatest honor of my life — electing me the Senate President in 2013. In 2020, I led Republican efforts to retake the majority in the State Senate. New Hampshire was the only state in the country that was able to flip a blue state legislature to red and it was largely due to our strong fight against the Democrats’ proposed state income tax. Last year, we passed one of the most conservative and fiscally responsible budgets that New Hampshire has ever seen. It is balanced, cuts taxes for small businesses, provides more than $300 million in property tax relief, bans late-term abortions, and prohibits the use of discriminatory teaching in our schools. It puts New Hampshire on a path to long-term prosperity. The work ethic, commitment to family and sense of community that I learned at a young age have stuck with me as an adult and drive everything I do. I still wake up at 4am every morning to work at our business before going to Concord to do the people’s business. More often than not, I still take my first phone calls of the day while driving a tractor. Washington, D.C. has enough silver-spoon, Ivy League lawyers. I believe that I am a product of all the best parts of New Hampshire — the spirit of freedom, sense of volunteerism and responsibility of giving back to the community that has helped shape me into the person I am today. I want to bring New Hampshire to Washington and makes sure our voices are heard. I want to bring New Hampshire values to a place that needs them now more than ever. I want to work for you and I hope you will consider electing me to represent you in the U.S. Senate.

| | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** **Kevin Hayslett Wins the Official Republican Party of Pinellas County Straw Poll**
_Internal Poll Shows Hayslett Surging as Race is now Statistically Tied_ **Clearwater, FL -** This weekend, former prosecutor and small business owner Kevin Hayslett won the official straw poll conducted by the Republican Party of Pinellas County at their Republican Candidate Showcase. By winning this key straw poll, Hayslett continues to build momentum and solidify himself as the frontrunner as the campaign released an internal poll that showed Hayslett statistically tied for the lead.

In the Republican Party of Pinellas County [straw poll](https://hayslettforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1bed80455017e0c6f06266c32&id=f9e3f50ea3&e=c927abcf3e), Hayslett received 44% of the vote, while two time Congressional candidate Amanda Makki received 31% of the vote, and Anna Paulina Luna received only 17% of the vote.

Pinellas County Supervisor of Elections Julie Marcus and her staff worked in conjunction with the Republican Party of Pinellas County on July 31st, 2022 to ensure the integrity of the straw poll. Marcus has served as the Supervisor of Elections since 2019 and has made the safety and security of all elections in Pinellas County her top priority.

Last week, the Kevin Hayslett for Congress campaign [released a poll](https://hayslettforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1bed80455017e0c6f06266c32&id=2e04c14b23&e=c927abcf3e) that showed Hayslett and Luna statistically tied for the Republican nomination in FL-13. This came less than a month after polling found Luna to have a 23 point lead over Hayslett and a 29 point lead over Amanda Makki. It is clear the momentum has shifted to Hayslett and that his Trump Tough and Law and Order message is resonating with voters. His experience as a prosecutor is only further backed by his endorsements of Pinellas County Sheriff Bob Gualtieri and Polk County Sheriff Grady Judd.

“The people of Pinellas County want someone they can count on to stick up for them in Congress. I'm a Trump Tough Republican, I’m here to fight, and I’m here to take on the out of touch Biden-Pelosi agenda,” stated Hayslett. “The Democrats have been in charge for two years and they’ve done a lifetime of damage. It’s time to put our country and our communities first, and that’s exactly what I’ll do in Congress.” # # #

| | Friend, The first day of school is just around the corner, and as a mom, I know just how stressful this time of year can be — _especially_ when so many in our community don’t have basic support, like paid family leave or affordable child care. Peter,

I wanted to take a moment to thank you for your support ahead of last month's fundraising deadline. Thanks to you, we've recorded our strongest fundraising month to date. That’s a huge feat, and it's a testament to our growing momentum.

I don’t think I'm overstating this: If we successfully win this race and keep IL-17 blue, we'll point back to your early support as a major factor in our success.

From the beginning, this has been about giving voters across Northwest Illinois the voice in Congress we deserve. If you only watch cable news, there's a foregone conclusion that we're going to be stuck with far-right extremists like my opponent Esther King in the House. Peter,

I'm not sure exactly why or how this is happening... but it's causing quite the stir.

[](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=7852f5a1c9224b9e8f7e1d8e69ca573c&_e=IFLPvgY04ITGI3YgsnKPdP6RZ91csehI_HBam8EtdDAx0ezEf0AF80KUcbZ0RAQPvCTBzVY_0pRvAeIolkgB3tvDx9tC_WGxrQK7FmEjT4etgP1oY4259lgWLMpgYVW2RLoo-9O085r5OGnysiiKrB6PW6urhwA8PYtQdKoBV1MJHiepuwdG09jDMYp2H7xq3cZH-nUlksgheyNMYaruI4ipow0cwAIuSSjEWOuc84-boCyinPtpwXaQWmDwoesVOgYVs1P-betxr4q4btYLLIjMOAUAXlT4MtbgNsCEhTcqiQ6E9dIhsqCY-NrJGsCI0cqdJFauXGdRAMYwVyFgCGcdLuBBz1rLxtG6zmpXjx6cgB1tBSQa4fd8OTvnAP-pXaY7oXrckGhaNn2wwvP6eU-U3_6vdCwRF_ubQf21xxaZv5vmIJndQJPUgYxDZ0htkW6SGcNeCXvGaKpFhIlr8vAUJXst8_HHLosL8I9Op1z3Nt7q2IXEeBsPd_rRl7gI)
With President Biden's approval rating at just 38%, Democrats should be in no position to win the midterm elections. However, their grassroots donor base is highly motivated and is donating almost three times as much as our conservative donors.

name: John Fetterman
subject: Actually kind of hilarious
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
I grew up in PA and I’m raising my family here. My opponent can’t say the same.
#
Derek, wanna know what’s a really weird sensation?
**The feeling of watching your Republican opponent for U.S. Senate play tourist in the town you grew up in. 🙄**
I mean, it was actually kind of hilarious to see Dr. Oz on the campaign trail in my hometown of York, PA earlier this week. He took a photo at New Eastern Market which is a *classic* York landmark.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220802-2?refcode=em20220802-6717&refcode2=6717_434096_nRKT47&akid=6717%2E434096%2EnRKT47)
_It’s not every day a REAL New Jersey 🤩 Celebrity Doctor comes to York, PA!_
New Eastern Market has been operating since the late 1880s, and my parents have been shopping there for as long as I can remember. In fact, they’ve lived in the same house (about three miles from New Eastern Market) since 1975.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220802-2?refcode=em20220802-6717&refcode2=6717_434096_nRKT47&akid=6717%2E434096%2EnRKT47)
_Dad + Me in the 1970s_
We had a family routine: After New Eastern, my brother Gregg and I would pester Mom to take us to the Hills for a new Lego kit (KiddyTown had the best selection, tbh). I can still smell the popcorn 🍿 in the lobby.
NOTHING beats summer in York when you’re a kid! In the 1980s, Gregg and I would spend countless hours at Avalon's Golf at the York Mall. They had Donkey Kong in the arcade which, of course, is in the pantheon of video games. 😎
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220802-2?refcode=em20220802-6717&refcode2=6717_434096_nRKT47&akid=6717%2E434096%2EnRKT47)
_Mom + Me in the 1980s, wearing my favorite Pyromania Def Leppard shirt._
I ❤️ York, PA and it will always have a place in my heart.
I’m grateful that York is where my parents decided to raise their family when they were just starting out on their own. And I’m grateful that Gisele and I are raising our family in Braddock, PA so they can experience the York memories of my childhood, too.
**Dr. Oz, on the other hand, didn’t grow up in PA, doesn’t live in PA, and didn’t raise his family in PA.**
I mean, he literally voted in New Jersey as recently as 2020. Seriously???!!!
Derek, hopefully now you can understand why seeing Dr. Oz in my hometown is actually kind of hilarious. This guy is just so out of touch.
**Send me to Washington, and I’ll fight for you with the same honesty + commitment I have for our beautiful Commonwealth of Pennsylvania.**
[**_Will you please make your very first donation of $5 to my campaign for U.S. Senate today? Anything you’re able to give has a direct + immediate impact on our campaign to defeat Dr. Oz and win Pennsylvania in 2022._**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220802-2?refcode=em20220802-6717&refcode2=6717_434096_nRKT47&akid=6717%2E434096%2EnRKT47)
**[Donate Now »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220802-2?refcode=em20220802-6717&refcode2=6717_434096_nRKT47&akid=6717%2E434096%2EnRKT47)**
Thank you,
—John
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania

Peter,
---
Polls show that Americans see economic issues like inflation and the cost of living as the biggest issues they’re facing ahead of the November elections.
---
_But Annette Taddeo won’t do anything to solve them._
---
_She’s been called “the right-hand man” of Joe Biden in Florida, and she fully supports his failed policies and reckless spending packages that created this inflationary crisis in the first place._
---
But now, Taddeo is telling voters that they should trust the Democrats to handle our economy, and if we keep them in power in November, they’ll solve all the problems they created.
---

Team,
We just wanted to make sure you saw – Elissa’s primary is today.
While Elissa is out talking to voters in the new 7th district, we wanted to resend her message from this afternoon. You can take a look below.
We’ll be sure to follow up with you on all of the details of tonight's results, but in the meantime we wanted to ask if you would consider chipping in before the polls close. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220802_2&amount=28]
If President Trump’s last minute endorsement of one of the Republican gubernatorial candidates is any indication, it’s going to be a busy few months as we work to keep Elissa’s seat in one of the ten most competitive races in the entire country – anything you can give now will help us be ready for anything that comes our way. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220802_2&amount=28]
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220802_2&amount=28]
Team Slotkin
Team,
It’s primary day in Michigan, so I wanted to send a quick note to tell you a bit about what I’ll be looking for after the polls close at 8pm.
First off: I don’t have a primary opponent, but I will be looking to see how many folks in the new district made it out to the polls, and what turnout looks like. I’ll be watching who turned out for my opponent, as well. He currently has a challenger running a self-funded write-in campaign, and he’s taking it seriously. He even got Trump’s top lieutenant in Michigan to do a last minute MAGA-themed voicemail for him to GOP voters. [https://twitter.com/BrettAGillespie/status/1554235965920759814] So I’ll be interested in seeing the numbers in his race.
But more broadly, across the state of Michigan, we’ll be learning a lot about the future of the GOP, and their path forward as a party. We had some developments this weekend, when former President Trump joined forces with the DeVos family and formally endorsed Tudor Dixon, one of the candidates running for the Republican gubernatorial nomination. She has been the DeVos family’s preferred candidate for months -- the DeVos family members are also some of my opponent's strongest donors, with their support stretching across his near-decade in politics. (That's likely why he has never once supported a K-12 education budget).
The endorsement of Dixon made the front page of national newspapers [https://www.nytimes.com/live/2022/07/29/us/primary-elections-midterms] – and it hasn’t exactly made some grassroots Trump supporters, who had thrown their support behind the other candidates, happy. In fact, many had specifically called for the former president to avoid working with his former Education Secretary, Betsy DeVos. This is especially interesting as a number of other primary races in Michigan have seen the DeVos family and other conservative donors join forces against Trump-backed candidates.
Ultimately, what we’re seeing in today’s Michigan primaries is the months-long fight between Trump-style conservatives and the more traditional wing of the Republican party come to a head. We’ll have a good sense tomorrow what camp voters would like to see control the Michigan GOP.
Whatever results do come out of today’s primary will heavily influence the remaining 98 days of this campaign. So, I’m asking if you’ll chip in a few bucks to help us be as prepared as possible to take on whatever comes our way in the next few months! Elissa

---
| | **BIG JANUARY 6TH UPDATE: Rep. Liz Cheney announced that the January 6th Committee may subpoena Ginni Thomas, wife of Supreme Court Justice Clarence Thomas.** Remember: **We already know that Ginni Thomas attempted to influence Arizona Republican lawmakers to overturn the results of the 2020 election.** We also know that Thomas sent messages to Trump’s Chief of Staff, Mark Meadows, urging him to continue efforts to contest the 2020 election. subject: Post-primary note
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY PEOPLE FOR PATTY MURRAY
body:
I just wanted to say...
#
Well, Peter, the primary has officially wrapped. As we wait for the final results to come in, I just wanted to reach out and say THANK YOU!
Your support means so much to me – and it’s what has fueled this campaign from the very beginning.

name: Ralph Rebandt For Governor
subject: Prayer Call Tonight
body:
Join us in prayer tonight

| [ ](http://www.ralphrebandtforgovernor.com/?e=35c30c37841d37cfa9d73635bc93e640&utm_source=ralphrebandtforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=prayer_call_4&n=1)
---
**Join The Prayer Call Tonight** **Tonight, Tuesday 10:45 pm** **Call 605-313-4829** **Then enter 694177#** For anyone who would like to join in Praying and Fasting, we have a team that will be praying and fasting the entire day of the election. Here are some things that we can flood the throne of God with together, as we join together- \- Father, Son Jesus Christ, and Holy Spirit, we acknowledge and glorify you as God, we give you Praise. \- We confess our shortcomings, and ask your forgiveness. \- We are SO THANKFUL Lord that you have brought us this far! \- Lord, Ralph meets the qualifications of whom You Lord have said you will look to in Isaiah 66. The one who is humble, contrite in spirit, and trembles at Your Word. Please Lord, as we your people ask in agreement, please listen to the voice of Your children in Michigan as we ask for our choice for Governor in Michigan to be Ralph Rebandt. Lord, the only reason we ask this so passionately of You is that we believe He is Your choice as he meets these qualifications. Your will be done, on earth as it is in heaven, Lord. We believe You are Able! \- That every heart and every mind that is able to vote will hear about Ralph, and be inclined to vote for him. \- That God would appoint 'an east wind' when the sun rises on election day, bringing about a miraculous win for Ralph on August 2nd, 2022. \- That God would work with wave upon wave in the hearts and minds of each voter, with an overflow of what is needed to win this election. \- That God would use everything- individual efforts, letters to churches, flyers in car handles and windows, commercials, text messages, rallies, people, radio, and Anything else possible to get Ralph to the seat of Governor in Michigan if it is His Will. Ralph desires Psalm 138:2, "Your Name and Your Word you have elevated above all else." \- That the Holy Spirit would make up ALL the difference in our weaknesses in how we do not know how to pray- "Likewise the Spirit helps us in our weakness. For we do not know what to pray for as we ought, but the Spirit himself intercedes for us with groanings too deep for words." (Romans 8:26) Holy Spirit, please intercede Yourself for us in this area of prayer as you have promised to do. May the Will of the Father be done, in Jesus Name. Praise God, from Whom All Blessings Flow. Lord, we look to You. In Jesus Name, Amen! Thank you for your continued support. Ralph Rebandt For Governor

subject: Major Victory!
body:
When I pledged not to take money from big corporations, I was told fundraising would be a challenge if we relied on small dollar donors. Our opponent only has to appeal to a few large donors, while we need and want a large donor base of regular Vermonter | |
---
Friend, We out-raised the Governor for the second time in a row! **** When I pledged not to take money from big corporations, I was told fundraising would be a challenge if we relied on small dollar donors. Our opponent only has to appeal to a few large donors, while we need and want a large donor base of regular Vermonters. **** We’ve been able to do the seemingly impossible. We've out-raised Governor Scott in the first two major filings. And we did it because of all of you. **** Vermonters showed up, like we always do. We had 12 times the number of individual contributions as my opponent, and one of his contributors was a pharmaceutical company. I have pledged to not take any money from big pharma or fuel companies because I know that Vermonters deserve more. It is regular people supporting this movement and I am so grateful for that. Against all odds, our campaign of the many is succeeding. Americans are tired of politicians who cater to the needs of a wealthy few. Our campaign is showing that politicians can fundraise by appealing to the masses instead. I’m beyond proud of what we’ve accomplished together.

clean_body: When I pledged not to take money from big corporations, I was told fundraising would be a challenge if we relied on small dollar donors. Our opponent only has to appeal to a few large donors, while we need and want a large donor base of regular Vermonter | | Friend, We out-raised the Governor for the second time in a row! ** When I pledged not to take money from big corporations, I was told fundraising would be a challenge if we relied on small dollar donors. Our opponent only has to appeal to a few large donors, while we need and want a large donor base of regular Vermonters. We’ve been able to do the seemingly impossible. We've out-raised Governor Scott in the first two major filings. And we did it because of all of you. ** Vermonters showed up, like we always do. We had 12 times the number of individual contributions as my opponent, and one of his contributors was a pharmaceutical company. I have pledged to not take any money from big pharma or fuel companies because I know that Vermonters deserve more. It is regular people supporting this movement and I am so grateful for that. Against all odds, our campaign of the many is succeeding. Americans are tired of politicians who cater to the needs of a wealthy few. Our campaign is showing that politicians can fundraise by appealing to the masses instead. I’m beyond proud of what we’ve accomplished together. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: We still have a lot of ground to make up to win this election. As of now, we don’t have enough resources to send out mailers or get on TV. We now have just a week to be ready, and I am counting on all of you to help us get there. Governor Scott has a great deal of cash on hand, and he will likely dip into those funds as we get closer to election day. But our victory shows that we have what it takes to win this election. We’ve built a truly grassroots campaign, and we’re succeeding. Again, thank you so much for all of your support. Together we will be ready for what is to come from Washington. We are showing every day that Vermonters don’t want the status quo. We are ready for change and together we will bring it. Your Friend, Brenda | | Copyright (C) 2022 Brenda for Vermont. | | I could not be more grateful for the support our campaign received tonight. While there are still many more votes to be counted – and we _must_ count every vote – tonight's results reflect the work, values, and shared commitment of so many supporters and volunteers across Northwest Washington. **I want to extend to each and every one of you my personal note of thanks.** From those who stood with us in Bellingham and Mount Vernon in passionate support of a woman's right to choose after the leaked Supreme Court decision overturning _Roe v. Wade,_ to those who rallied with us in Everett for new gun violence prevention laws after the tragedy in Uvalde. From those at the small aviation parts factories who shared how the Aviation Manufacturing Jobs Protection Program allowed them to survive to the pandemic to the residents in Lynden, Blaine, Edmonds, and other areas new to the Second Congressional District who took time out of their busy days to talk with us on their doorsteps and share their thoughts on an economy that works for them. **It is only with _your_ grassroots energy and unity that our campaign can advance past the primary and onto the general election, and it is only with your energy and unity that we can prevail in November as well.** And, of course, I want to recognize and thank my dedicated and hardworking staff for keeping this campaign organized and on track every step of the way. **As these past few weeks have shown, there is still plenty that Congress must accomplish and _can_ accomplish for working families.** Tonight brings us one step closer to continuing our important work to grow local family wage jobs, fight climate change, lower costs and expand access to health care, prevent gun violence, and protect reproductive freedom. It is the honor of a lifetime to represent our region in Congress — one that I will never take for granted. Between now and November, I will work just as tirelessly on the campaign trail to earn the vote of every resident of Northwest Washington as I am working on your behalf in Washington, D.C. _Rick_
